notes.title: Steam Deck-optimized version of Startup Company
notes.notes:
Dear Startup Company players,

We have some exciting news to share with you. We are introducing a new version of the game that has been optimized for use with controllers. This means that the game will be fully compatible with the Steam Deck and other controller-based devices.

We recommend that players on desktop computers continue to play the regular version of the game as it provides the best experience in terms of gameplay, modding, and overall performance. However, if you prefer to play using a controller, the new controller-optimized version of the game will provide an equally immersive and enjoyable experience.

Please note that the controller-optimized version of Startup Company will not support modding, and savegames between the two versions are not compatible/shared.

To choose between the two versions, simply start the game as usual and you'll be prompted to select the desired game version:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/f967cb4fdbb6e0d647eac7e7337a1ff6451c834a.png[/img]

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm for Startup Company. We hope you enjoy the new controller-optimized version of the game!

Sincerely,
Hovgaard Games

notes.title: Our new game "Big Ambitions" is now available on Steam Early Access!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We're incredibly happy and equally scared to finally release our new game, [i][b]Big Ambitions[/b][/i], into Steam Early Access.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1331550/Big_Ambitions/

[h1]Big Ambitions is a revolutionary role-playing business sim[/h1]

[i][b]Big Ambitions[/b][/i] is the successor to [i]Startup Company[/i]. While [i]Startup Company[/i] was all about large internet-based businesses, [i][b]Big Ambitions[/b][/i] focuses much more on the small retail businesses that grow to become huge empires.

To quickly give you an understanding of the game, here's a list of its key features:

[list]
[*] [b]Huge Business Sandbox[/b] - Go from nothing to the most prominent tycoon in New York. Whether one business or multiple, work smart and make them thrive.
[*] [b]Grow any Business[/b] - Start your own gift shop, supermarket, coffee shop, or law firm. Whether it’s a single shop or making millions developing websites from a basement.
[*] [b]Incredibly In-depth [/b]- Take out a loan, rent multiple buildings, design their logos, renovate your stores, grab stock, manage your money, hire staff, and create your infrastructure. 
[*] [b]Life Sim on Steroids [/b]- Need a delivery truck? Travel to a dealer and buy one. Need food? Head to a supermarket, just make sure you have a refrigerator back at home.
[*] [b]Own New York City[/b] - Enter any building in New York and buy it. Go from a small apartment to a dream penthouse in midtown or buy a series of skyscrapers. 
[*] [b]Fast Cars or Investment Funds[/b] - Spend your wealth however you wish. Buy a big SUV, a speedy sports car, or the new luxurious Mersaidi S500. Maybe even risk it all at the casinos.
[*] [b]Make it to Retirement, or don't [/b]- Make sure you get enough sleep and stay healthy and happy. Enjoy the journey, for as you grow older, you’ll discover that money can’t buy you time... or can it?
[/list]

If you want to read more about our journey developing Big Ambitions, as well as its Early Access Roadmap, I recommend checking out the official Steam announcement: 

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1331550/view/3653020827586553519

We really hope you'll like it and thank you so much for reading!

All the best,

[i]Jonas and the Big Ambitions team[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1331550/Big_Ambitions/

notes.title: Introducing "Big Ambitions"
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/0ccc778401326c13731e46ae2a88a2265cac98ae.png[/img]

Hey there!

After working on my first game Startup Company for more than 5 years, I’m finally ready to announce the title of my next game:

[b]Big Ambitions[/b]

The website is online too: [url=https://www.bigambitionsgame.com]https://www.bigambitionsgame.com[/url]

To give you a better understanding of what Big Ambitions is all about, we should take a look at the beginning of the game.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/ec5674dfc261732196edf1fd14070d07f56d567b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/ec5674dfc261732196edf1fd14070d07f56d567b.png[/img][/url]

To give you an understanding of what Big Ambitions is all about, we should start at the very beginning of the game:

[h1]The New Beginning[/h1]
You’re eighteen years old and living in your parents’ apartment in downtown New York. You have big aspirations to make money and become successful.

However, before you can start on your journey, you need to earn some money.

[h2]Getting a job[/h2]
The city offers hundreds of jobs, from flipping burgers to driving New Yorkers around in a taxicab. It’s up to you to decide which path you take.

With a few thousand in the bank, you can finally rent your own space and start working on your empire. Most tycoons start simple: A restaurant, a small supermarket, or even an auto repair shop. It’s up to you, try to choose something that’s in demand for the specific area of the city you’re staying in.

As you continue along your journey to success, both your wealth and life will change. With more money comes more problems.

[h1]Objectives and Goals[/h1]
Your goal in Big Ambitions is to become the biggest city tycoon in New York. Your daily tasks will vary between:
[list]
[*] Buying & selling real estate
[*] Setting up and managing businesses such as restaurants, supermarkets, offices and more
[*] Securing deliveries of goods for your businesses
[*] Renovating owned properties
[*] Managing employees
[*] Taking care of yourself by sleeping, eating, working out and more
[/list]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/4ca98643b046498269026bfe63324bb954c45dd8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/4ca98643b046498269026bfe63324bb954c45dd8.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Lifecycle and limitations[/h1]
The game comes with a full day & night cycle following a real-life schedule with rush hours, weekends and more.

You have 3 main factors to maintain: Energy, Hunger and Happiness. To function as effectively as possible, you need to keep all three in balance.

As aforementioned, your journey starts at the age of eighteen, but as you play your character will move through the three stages of adulthood (each having their own advantages and disadvantages):
[list]
[*] Young
[*] Middle-aged
[*] Old
[/list]

[h1]Engine, controls and perspective[/h1]
Big Ambitions is my first game developed with an industry-standard game engine: Unity 2020. Unlike Startup Company, the game will be 3D and you will control your character using a point-and-click navigation system (similar to the one found in the Diablo franchise). However, vehicles will be controlled using the keyboard.

The game is viewed from an isometric top-down camera angle and you’ll be able to zoom in, zoom out and rotate the camera which will always follow your character.

[h1]The City[/h1]
The game will be set in the bustling centre of New York City. I focus on ensuring that the streets feel as authentic as possible since I really want you, the player, to feel like part of New York City. As part of my quest to deliver an authentic city experience, I’m making it so that every building in the city can be interacted with and owned. The first public build (Beta 1) will come with the following city map:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/e88272ff15c512af9eedaaa3ecbb46a4b47c1519.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/e88272ff15c512af9eedaaa3ecbb46a4b47c1519.png[/img][/url]
[i]I expect the final map to be 4 times bigger.[/i]

[h1]Development and release date[/h1]
Similar to Startup Company, I’ll be the only developer working full time on the game. Fortunately, I’ll be hiring contractors to help me produce some core components such as the 3D models, complex Unity systems, UI design, music and sound effects.

I plan to release devlogs showcasing the progress on average once a week. I’ll also continue streaming the development on Twitch: [url=https://www.twitch.tv/jhovgaard]https://www.twitch.tv/jhovgaard[/url]

Since I have, no pun intended, big ambitions for the game, I expect at least 2 years of development before the first build is ready for the public. It’s definitely a long time away but I don’t want to take any shortcuts so that I can provide the best possible experience.

I’m determined to build a game that does more than entertain you - something that makes you dream big after closing the game.

I hope you’re as excited about Big Ambitions as I am. I cant wait to show you what I’ve got lined up for future devlogs, so make sure to [url=https://www.bigambitionsgame.com]subscribe to the newsletter on the website[/url][/b].

Thank you for reading!

All the best,
Jonas

notes.title: Startup Company is out in Full Release!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/f5b869a8a17b843a8adb704adbc80a3eecc756ff.png[/img]

Hi everyone! 

Today is the day! After four years and nine months of hard work, I can finally and proudly announce the Full Release of Startup Company!

If you read my [url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791458214897/announcements/detail/1711868557327266026]special devlog about how Startup Company became a thing[/url], you can probably imagine how excited I am about this. Today is the day I'm releasing the game I've been dreaming about. Startup Company is now officially out of Early Access.

[h1]Introducing Version 1 - Packed with new stuff![/h1]
I hope you're ready for this, because this update will be much longer than you're used to. Here's what's new in Version 1...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png[/img]
[h1]2 New Website Types[/h1]
By popular demand, you can now start the following two new website types: [b]Dating Platform[/b] & [b]Gaming Platform[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/30dbfbc10aa472fa4d7cb9e1c88a1b24c23858f3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png[/img]
[h1]New feature: Profile Page[/h1]
A new Profile Page feature is now available for all Gaming & Dating platforms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/c52207398b23a8e1af25b543661792320e91e792.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png[/img]
[h1]20 New Competitors[/h1]
With the new website types, I had to add some new competitors too. I asked my colleague Mark for some help naming these new competitors. As you can see, he was surprisingly creative!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/d63452af353a1734dcf113e6f66f197197cffc6a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png[/img]
[h1]New feature: Early Retirement[/h1]
Some of you really wanted to be able to retire early. I've listened and you can now find a "Retire now" button in your CEO's Retirement menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/32ea20d65517d091203a67cf24383655c18e468b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png[/img]
[h1]Employees Menu: Mass-Upgrades![/h1]
I got more requests for this feature than I could count. Now it's here, upgrade all your employees at once!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/72b9c952f69e839c6f82b518e3a34370e08c538f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png[/img]
[h1]Customize the "Days per year"[/h1]
In order to get a nice balance between simulating a day's work and the progression of years, I've ended up shortening a year to 50 days in Startup Company. Some of you really did not like that, so I added the option to define the length of a year through the Custom Game menu:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/12a3fdf6501110b82b9d1d471772a30f8b5288bc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png[/img]
[h1]New feature: Sell Your Website[/h1]
This feature request has been so popular that you'll even find mods adding the functionality. I'm happy to report that it's now natively in the game. Obviously websites can only be sold if you've already bought out all the investors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/6ae6d1ff5feca48c9e81bba8bcd64b5ef8875ddb.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png[/img]
[h1]In-game Achievements[/h1]
As Version 1 introduces a "direct download" option, I have created an achievements menu in-game, meaning achievements are no longer limited to Steam users.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/e28ca3aab2de932b6b4f4ffa80f571a0b6ecab47.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png[/img]
[h1]New office items![/h1]
We've now got some new cool items for your office:
[list]
[*] [b]Huge Slide:[/b] What's a big headquarter without a huge slide?
[*] [b]Game Console Area:[/b] Again, a sign of success. You need it.
[*] [b]Large Plant & Rectangular Plant:[/b] This is the sequal to the current "plant in a vase."
[*] [b]Indoor Tree:[/b] Big offices always have indoor trees for some reason. Now you can too.
[*] [b]Privacy Walls:[/b] Give your employees a bit more privacy with these walls.
[*] [b]Privacy Box:[/b] A box canceling all noise coming from inside it. Very modern.
[*] [b]Egg Chair:[/b] Probably the most expensive chair in the world.
[*] [b]Letters (A-Z):[/b] Motivate (or unmotivate) your employees with these letter-shaped objects.
[/list]
All the new items except the letters can be demanded by new employees and come with various new bonuses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/6d37508abfba5573503f989c9ebbee526ec7a3c4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png[/img]
[h1]Improved HR Management[/h1]
Most of you have probably experienced losing a good employee, simply because you didn't accept a salary raise in time. You can now let your HR Managers handle this.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/668c3037c3881e1527b1c1228beefac568ef0f77.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png[/img]
[h1]Better Production Plans[/h1]
The production plans has now been moved to an independent tab of the Inventory Menu. Options to more precisely control production behavior has also been added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/5f6a31b50c7f22cb420b6f27389577812024f1cb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png[/img]
[h1]Other Improvements[/h1][list]
[*] Fixed components incorrectly shown as locked.
[*] "Game paused" shown when the time machine running.
[*] Slider's maximum salary too low.
[*] Limited Help System to one instance per website.
[*] Reduced organic growth.
[*] Introduced Jeets earlier in the game.
[*] Added logo selector to "new game dialog."
[*] Improved auto-save to save only after further progression.
[*] Added random name generator to "new game" dialog.
[*] HR manager's exhaustion is now easier to understand.
[*] Newly hired employees can no longer be fired right away.
[*] Fixed overlays causing people to get stuck on slower computers.
[*] Fixed bug allowing outsourcing tasks to be completed instantly.
[*] Purchased furniture can now be sold again.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png[/img]
[h1]Bugs and balancing[/h1]
As with any release, there will of course be bugs and changes that need rebalancing. As always, I'll monitor the Steam discussions and apply hotfixes ASAP. 

I'm also planning on releasing a few updates to address various UI/QOL issues.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png[/img]
[h1]What's next at Hovgaard Games?[/h1]
So much! As we're now a full-blown company with the resources to explore multiple paths, our roadmap looks like this:

[h2]Localizor.com[/h2]
With Localizor we're revolutionizing the way games are translated by building an intelligent and community/crowd-based platform. We'll continue to invest heavily in improving the platform.
[url=https://www.localizor.com]Visit Localizor.com[/url]

[h2]The Next Game[/h2]
I can't count how many times I've been asked, "Is there another game coming from Hovgaard Games?" I can finally reply with a confident "Hell yes!" 

We're already busy creating the first concept art and I can't wait to show you everything. For now, I'll give you a few hints: [list]
[*] It's once again a tycoon/management game.
[*] The camera angle is topdown/isometric and the gameplay is something we're confident you have never seen before in this genre.
[*] The budget for the new game is 50 times (!) bigger than it was for Startup Company.
[/list]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/hovgaard][b]Make sure to follow Hovgaard Games on Steam to stay updated![/b][/url]

Once again! I hope you enjoy Startup Company – now in it's final form ːschappyː

Thanks for reading and for your continuing support!

All the best,
Jonas and the Hovgaard Games team

notes.title: It's been a long journey
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone!

As you probably already imagine from the title, this will be a very special devlog.

First, let's get right to the practical: [b]the official release date of the Startup Company Full Version will be announced in next week. We'll finally leave Early Access and the Beta program[/b].
To celebrate, I'd like to share my story with all of you, who have been following my game for the last couple of years. It's a long read, so if you're only curious about game updates, you should probably stop reading now ːschappyː

Let's get started. It was back in 2015...

[h1]The Beginning[/h1]
I was working a 9-5 corporate job as a Lead Developer. My primary task was to build websites, and I knew absolutely nothing about game development. But I loved tycoon games, and I had the desire to make one myself.

One evening, around July 2015, I was casually playing around with combining web technology (HTML, CSS, and Javascript) with some free isometric game assets I had found online. I had no goal at all. I was just curious if it was possible. Slowly, I started understanding how I could layer multiple PNG images on top of each other and make the website look like a game. It was incredibly simple, but it felt real. I continued testing ideas and researching possibilities. After a couple of weeks of investigation, I came to a conclusion: I could definitely build a game entirely in HTML, CSS, and Javascript. I was experienced in all these technologies. The only limitation was that I had to keep the animations simple.

[h1]The Idea[/h1]
Back when I was younger, I had tried starting up two companies. The first was a hosted e-commerce platform, basically a competitor to Shopify. We spent a year developing the platform in our spare time, but failed miserably when we learned that developers can't sell anything and that marketing is important. After that, I built a platform to manage web servers. It failed, too, because I still hadn't learned anything.
However, with my newly found knowledge about game development, I was ready for my third adventure. I knew that I could build a game. I just had to decide what I would build. Fortunately, it couldn't have been more obvious: I needed to build a game that would allow me to succeed in starting a company. I quickly jumped on Steam and searched for "Startup Company"...0 results. Boom, that was it.

[h1]Livecoding[/h1]
I had been working on the concept for a couple of months. I even found an up and coming artist from India, who was willing to provide me with cheap assets (I think I paid $20 per item) to get started.
At the time, I was working mainly in the evenings, after work. That left me with 2 problems. First, I had already programmed for 8 hours, so I was tired and slow at solving complex problems. Second, I procrastinated too much by watching Twitch streams, chatting with friends, etc. 

To overcome these issues, I decided to start streaming my development. Exactly like regular Twitch streams, but with me writing code.

Game development streams weren’t really a thing on Twitch at the time, but there was a site called Livecoding for exactly that. I signed up, got my OBS configured, and went live Saturday, October 17, 2015.
I was too shy to use a webcam or even have a microphone. (English is not my native language.) Instead, I would reply to viewers directly via chat. I don't remember the duration of my first stream, but I remember the feeling: I had been incredibly productive.  Because someone was watching me (between 0-1 viewers), I couldn't chat with my friends or watch stupid videos on YouTube. Instead, I had to work and keep them entertained with my progress.

I continued streaming and my followers started climbing. I got confident and eventually added both a microphone and a cam to my stream. At my peak, I had up to 100 viewers every night. People even donated me money to invest in the game.

Here's the first preview I made of Startup Company:
[previewyoutube=Px7YmA0xAAk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]The Hustle[/h1]
As more and more people started following my development streams and signing up for my newsletter, I started to believe that I really had something.

With new motivation, I started to really put in the hours. Weekends were now dedicated to the game. I even had a rule that I had to work more hours on the game than on my full-time job, which obviously resulted in 70+ hour work weeks.

[h1]Beta 1[/h1]
After working on the game for almost 6 months, I was finally ready to release Beta 1. On February 21, 2016, I made Beta 1 available to everyone who had signed up. 

I remember feeling not only excited, but also very nervous. What if they didn't like it?

20 minutes later I got the first feedback. I remember it clearly: "lol, it's so boring." The feedback continued: "It feels like real work"; "This is spreadsheet simulator"; and so on.

At this point, I was seconds away from giving up completely. I didn't reply to anyone, and I didn't touch the game for days.
To this day, I'm not sure why I picked up the game again. But, fortunately, I did. I reached out to everyone who had given me feedback and started questioning them about everything. I wanted to figure out what they expected and wanted from the game.

Over the next year, I ended up rewriting the game completely two times. The root cause of the boring gameplay was my desire to make it complex and realistic. I tried to simulate real life "development models" and "deployment processes." Geeky stuff that sounded cool on paper, but was awful in a game. 

At last, I finally figured out that a game had to be simple enough for the player to fully understand what was going on. When playing a game, you want to understand exactly what is going on, so that you can make smart decisions. This is also the reason that I have insisted on keeping the game casual and sometimes unrealistic. I tried the opposite. 

It wasn't good.

[h1]The Early Access Release[/h1]
Fast forward a year. It's Summer 2017. The game had evolved a ton. It was a good experience, and people were playing it for an average of 2 hours.

I had already set the release date: August 11, 2017. The game was up on "Steam Coming Soon." I knew from my earlier failures as an entrepreneur that marketing was the most important thing, especially now, 3 months prior to the release.

At this point of time, I completely stopped working on the game. Instead, I went into full-blown marketing mode. I literally sent more than 500 emails with Steam keys to YouTubers and Twitchers. If they didn't reply to me, I would message them on Twitter or even crash their live stream on Twitch. I would even appear in their comments section. If you were contacted by me back then: I'm sorry, I know I must have been annoying.

A lot of small YouTubers covered the game. It started slowly. Most had fewer than 1,000 subscribers.
But then, my game was covered by "GrayStillPlays" on YouTube. The whole thing went nuts from there. The number of people wishlisting the game began climbing like never before.

On Friday August 11, 2017, I pushed the button on Steam and Startup Company went live. Within an hour, the game was on the frontpage of Steam. At its peak, the game had more than 1,400 people concurrently playing the game.

It took me a couple of days before I fully understood what had happened. The upcoming Monday I knocked on my boss' door, only to tell him that I would like to resign.

[h1]Life as a Game Developer[/h1]
I had to stay in the job for six weeks after my resignation. It was a stressful time. The huge increase in players caused a lot of bugs to show up. I couldn't accept it, if any of my players had a question that was unanswered or a bug that wasn't fixed right away.

At the same time, I had no experience in community management. I was way too emotionally attached to my game, and a single bad review would literally ruin my whole day, especially if it was valid.

Fortunately, I learned, over time, to handle all that stuff. Today, I work a healthy amount of hours, and I've read enough negative reviews for them to not change my mood. 

After the release, I started documenting all development progress through the devlogs here on Steam. (You can check them out, as they are all still available).

[h1]The Next Chapter[/h1]
Right now, I'm working on Version 1 of Startup Company. Obviously, I can't make a full release, without also bringing you the biggest content update for the game ever. So far, Version 1 contains more new content than the last 5 beta updates, and I'm only halfway done. If there's a time to be excited as a Startup Company player, it's now!

I'm also actively negotiating with another studio to help me bring Startup Company to Xbox, PlayStation, and Nintendo Switch. There will, of course, be an official announcement about this later.

And finally, me and my colleague Mark are working on Localizor, our new community translation platform, which has really started to take off lately. You can check it out here: [url=https://www.localizor.com]www.localizor.com[/url]

[h1]Thank You[/h1]
No matter how long you've been following me and Startup Company, I just want to say thank you for all your feedback, bug reports, ideas and suggestions, negative and positive reviews, mods in the workshop, and comments and likes on my devlogs.

Having a community like this is truly a blessing. Startup Company would never had been possible without you.

That's all for today. Remember to keep an eye on the announcements at the end of next week. Something is coming...

Thanks for reading!

All the Best,
Jonas

notes.title: Beta 29 is now available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/37d531c1a406cefad73aa7b5aa8ad0cea13d3f77.png[/img]

Hi there!

[b]Beta 29 is now available. Restart Steam to get it right away![/b]

It's been 42 days since the last beta update. While Beta 29 isn't the biggest update, it delivers some important changes. One of these changes has been in the pipeline for more than a year!

Let's jump right into it and see what's new.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png[/img]

[h1]CEO Backstory[/h1]
The CEO's backstory allows you to select which skill your CEO had before becoming a CEO. You'll be able to choose between developer, designer, or manager. No matter which role you choose, the CEO will still be able to participate in recruitment. All you have to do is manually switch between his roles.

The CEO is the first and only employee type that can handle multiple skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/fbf04b7b45770ff6c5fdcfc3708032697c63570f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png[/img]

[h1]New Fusion Hardware[/h1]
Beta 29 introduces brand new "Fusion" hardware. Both new hardware items are very expensive, but are also the most efficient seen so far.

[h3]Fusion Server[/h3]
Generates a lot of heat, but it's also the first server to produce all three types of throughput.

[h3]Fusion Heat Transformer[/h3]
Incredibly expensive but reduces temperature by a stunning -55 Celsius (-67 Fahrenheit).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/4ffe3b0190cbd31d328cdcaa2c2363c275722aa9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png[/img]

[h1]New Enhancement Feature: Help System[/h1]
This headline might be confusing. It's not an in-game help system – it's a new enhancement feature you can add to your website. Adding the Help System will not only allow you to increase overall satisfaction (it counts as a regular feature), but it also greatly reduces the number of generated support tickets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/2a9db4bf7b385fcab5c9d8a51cc1e202eb425bdb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png[/img]
[h1]Tidal Power Investment Project[/h1]
A third investment project is now available: Tidal Power. It will unlock both the Fusion Heat Transformer and the Fusion Server. The upfront payment is $28 million and the minimum daily budget is $1.2 million.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/a7a915feaa54c5e886cb995cf0cdde71b3ced655.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png[/img]
[h1]Minor changes[/h1]
Beta 29 also contains a lot of bug fixes and improvements. The most exciting ones are
[list]
[*] Employee Menu: Order by age added
[*] Retirement warnings added
[*] New achievements: "The Wave" & "Dangerous Future"
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png[/img]

[h1]Help us translate![/h1]
Even though the community has been very busy translating Beta 29, there are still a couple of untranslated strings. The following languages are incomplete: Portuguese (BR), French, German, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, and Turkish.

If you want to help out, whether it be voting for suggestions or writing your own, simply click the button below to get started:

[url=https://www.localizor.io/game/1/translations]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/66c7d3d26f6516cce3c7174c8facad75a11d49d3.png[/img]
[/url]
[url=https://www.localizor.io/game/1/translations]https://www.localizor.io/game/1/translations[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png[/img]

As always, I'll be monitoring the release very closely for any potential issues that might arise or that we might have missed during testing. If you encounter any issues or bugs, please send me a message on our Discord channel (link provided below) or create a post in the Steam discussions.

I really hope you like all the new changes and features!

Best,
Jonas

notes.title: Beta 28 is now available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/a2cc3a47e5f9a1d6e02c5a64ff452ced03700d61.png[/img]

Hi there!

[b]Beta 28 is now available. Restart Steam to get it right away![/b]

I'm happy to once again present you another big update for Startup Company. This update is really for you, as every single change and feature is based on community feedback.

Let's jump right into it and see what's new.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png[/img]
[h1]Dynamic DDoS Attacks & DDoS Protection[/h1]
In Beta 28 I have greatly increased the effect of DDoS attacks both in duration, strength and how often they happen.

To help you counter these attacks we're introducing another Enhancement Feature: The DDoS Protection. Similar to the Adblock Obfuscator you can improve the feature from 0-100%. At 100% you'll be almost invincible to DDoS attacks.

DDoS Protection has a flaw though: The system will automatically ask users if they are a robot or not. This will annoy your users and result in increased dissatisfaction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/48071932d8a42535c73a73aee3372eaf01a09a03.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png[/img]
[h1]Introducing Jitter[/h1]
Understanding your users is a vital part of succeeding as a startup. This is why we're introducing Jitter. Users will send out Jeets expressing their feelings.

You'll also get weekly updates from the StockTraders account giving you hints on what companies to invest in.

I'll introduce even more types of Jeets over the next beta releases.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/02b91c942229862a20353aa48511d1de289797fb.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png[/img]
[h1]Updated Stock Market and UI[/h1]
After a ton of requests (you guys really like investing in stocks), I've finally fixed the buggy stock market. Beta 28 will introduce brand new mechanics that makes the stocks much more dynamic.

The UI has also been updated:
[list]
[*] Added a transaction log to better track whether you're making money or not.
[*] Added a 1% trading fee for both buying and selling.
[*] Increased the amount of days stock prices are tracked.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/5a9e06f0656849dea44ba6b16f0973cca9776914.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png[/img]
[h1]Fusion Power Plant & Fusion Framework 2020[/h1]
The second investment project is now available: The Fusion Power Plant. Once you have completed this investment you'll unlock the Fusion Framework 2020 which allows to reach even higher feature levels and add more features to the same website.

The projects are incredibly expensive therefore it's only for well-established companies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/cfd1b5100fbbbbbbc6b720cae359f2844a3bcda7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png[/img]
[h1]Other minor changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Decreased the effect of Viral Boosts.
[*] Increase hours to recruit intermediate and expert employees.
[*] Decrease the chance of headhunting superstar employees.
[*] Added support for UI scaling as a replacement for "Big UI" (moved to top left corner of the main menu).
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png[/img]
[code]Do you have suggestions or ideas for the game?
Check out [url=https://ideas.startupcompanygame.com]our Conflux board[/url].[/code]

As always, I'll be monitoring the release very closely for any potential issues that might arise or that we might have missed during testing. If you encounter any issues or bugs, please send me a message in our Discord channel (link provided below) or create a post in the Steam discussions.

I really hope you like all the new changes and features!

Best,
Jonas

notes.title: Devlog #56
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

2 weeks ago Beta 27 was released. It has been very successful! Reviews has been more positive than ever, thank you! The build was also very stable, I have only spent 1 week on fixing bugs:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where retirement sequence didn't start from step 1.
[*] Fixed bug making it impossible to unlock "The Sun Is The Future"
[*] Recruitment: Changed max value of salary and bonus slider to support new superstar employees.
[*] Show daily payment when negotiating ad contracts
[*] Added "In stock" value to Production Plans
[*] Updated localization files
[*] Fixed yet another "Employees not retiring" bug
[*] Fixed bug where retirement tax percentage didn't update after transferring.
[*] Fixed bug where both main menu and game soundtrack would play simultaneous
[*] Fixed issue where "years till retirement" could go into negative
[*] Fixed bug where new candidates would contain fire demands right away.
[*] Fixed bug making it impossible to upgrade to new office for some old savegames.
[*] Fixed error being thrown if employee was fired while having their dialog open.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png[/img]
[h1]Beta 28 Sneak Peek: Jitter and the in-game browser![/h1]
Beta 28 will introduce a new in-game browser. The first website you can visit is Jitter. From here you can get:[list]
[*] Info on how to improve your website and what annoys your users.

notes.title: Beta 27 is now available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/6726e991b4e12a957fbfd54825b29f94bd28a534.png[/img]

Hi there!

[b]Beta 27 is now available. Restart Steam to get it right away![/b]

It has been [b]72 days[/b] since the latest beta (26) was released. I'm super excited to announce Beta 27, which is the biggest update to the game, both for content, and lines of code.

Let's jump right into it and see what's new.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png[/img]
[h1]Career Mode[/h1]
Beta 27 introduces a brand new Career Mode, which is also the new primary game mode.

When you start the game, your CEO will be 18 years old. As the game progresses your CEO will now age along with your employees. At the age of 67, you will retire and the game is over.

As you're playing, your main objective is to move money from the company account to your retirement fund to secure your future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/8ec86ecef3cd792a969212d70e78c82b1b7b62c5.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png[/img]
[h1]Custom Game[/h1]
"Custom Game" allows you to configure the game exactly how you like. Don't like investors? Turn it off. Don't like the new retirement feature? Turn it off. Hate that you have to research everything? Turn it off! Wanna go crazy and build your dream? Turn up your starting money.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/6fe33857af30f2777f4e528987001707ca6fcabc.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png[/img]
[h1]Retirement Fund[/h1]
From the CEO window you'll now able to access the Retirement tab. From here you can move money from your company account to your personal retirement fund. You'll have to think this through as your investors need to receive an equal cut (unless you have bought them out).

You'll also have to consider taxes. Paying out everything in the same year will hit you with a huge tax charge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/da8c1ec8b7f19eb7f05391ace094666bcd37f1ce.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png[/img]
[h1]Investment Projects[/h1]
If we look at the world today, most successful entrepreneurs are investing in massive projects which move the world forward. Elon Musk with SpaceX and Tesla. Jeff Bezos going to space with Blue Origin and Mark Zuckerberg is aiming to provide access to the internet to everyone with internet.org. In Startup Company Beta 27 you'll be able to do the same. Each investment project will give you access to special abilities. Investment Projects are accessed via the city map.

The projects are incredibly expensive therefore it's only for well-established companies.

Beta 27 introduces the first project out of 3: [b]Space-based Solar Power[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/dd226b9f0ec19d12d686f0e2aa935fffd84d4870.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png[/img]
[h1]Superstar Employees[/h1]
Have you ever worked with someone that was incredibly fast? In Beta 27 you'll now be able to hire those superstar employees.

The superstar employees are very rare and can only be found using expert-level Recruiters. They require a very high salary, but can also reach base speeds of up to 900%.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/ae1df1e033a9291bce6e044b15cc922b4ccfc687.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png[/img]
[h1]Improved Inventory[/h1]
The Inventory Menu is probably the least used feature in Startup Company. Hopefully, this will change with Beta 27.

You'll finally be able to see both consumption, demand and production for each component/module.

This new information will allow you to make your office more efficient and cut down on overproduction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/f10dc378f0971576b246479bd07937f9711d4dd1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png[/img]
[h1]Other minor changes[/h1]
[list][*] 7 brand new achievements.
[*] Ability to disable workstation limits (be aware of lag).
[*] Designed Company & Benefits menu.
[*] Increased game speed (twice as fast in 3x speed).
[*] Beginner Kits for all employees are automatically researched.
[*] Sliders/UI for Sales Executives has been improved.
[*] 27 various bug fixes.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28693489/70a17695ae1bb6781144e152e87fb0d77aeb030a.png[/img]
[code]Do you have suggestions or ideas for the game?
Check out [url=https://ideas.startupcompanygame.com]our Conflux board[/url].[/code]

As always, I'll be monitoring the release very closely for any potential issues that might arise or that we might have missed during testing. If you encounter any issues or bugs, please send me a message in our Discord channel (link provided below) or create a post in the Steam discussions.

I really hope you like all the new changes and features!

I have to go now, It's time to get started on Beta 28 ːschappyː

Best,
Jonas

Another week went by and another Daily Deal has come to an end. The impact on our Review Score has been enormous this time. I'll keep my eyes away from the reviews until things are back to normal. If you have any issues with the game, please reach out to my directly ( jonas@hovgaardgames.com or Discord). notes.title: Beta 26 Released!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/eba52c06ac510d0504576807959587f37b683142.png[/img]

Hi there!

[b]Beta 26 is now available. Restart Steam to get it right away![/b]

We're super excited to bring to you Beta 26, which introduces a very controversial feature: Outsourcing.

To understand why, we have to go back to Beta 17. Back then, we had something called "Contract Work". The feature was removed in Beta 17 because it was such an easy way to earn money. It was probably the most unpopular decision I have ever made. Fortunately the game ended up being much better, as I was finally able to correctly balance out websites. You can read the original devlog here: https://steamcommunity.com/games/606800/announcements/detail/1709565386033916765

Today, with Beta 26 we are reintroducing "Contract Work" as [b]Outsourcing[/b]. The feature has been completely rewritten and is now much more integrated with the rest of the game's ecosystem. It is "part 1" as I plan to introduce even more features in future updates.

[h1]Outsourcing: Completing tasks for money[/h1]
You can use Outsourcing in two ways. To deliver components and receive money, or to request components and pay money.

To generate extra income, you have to first hire an [b]Outsourcing Executive[/b]. Then you'll have to win the task by sending a good offer. The mechanics are similar to recruitment, but here you'll be competing against other companies.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/176f6c89b869eb821271a9d93a7410451b3cada2.gif[/img]

[h1]Outsourcing: Get components/modules delivered[/h1]
The second part of outsourcing is getting other companies/competitors to deliver components and modules to your company.

This is especially useful if you have a sudden demand for some specific components or modules or if you simply don't have the space to hire more employees.

To create a task simply use your Outsourcing Executive. You can define up to 4 requirements (max 500 each). The shorter the deadline you define the more expensive it will be.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/0081a7ba9b7e2483fb56d2f7526138b56ad3518f.gif[/img]


[h1]Outsourcing: Market Prices[/h1]
The new Market Prices Menu allows you to make clever choices based on the demand and prices of specific components/modules.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/2339b616eef0e9c4f36c25123a5a3a869ae72dd5.jpg[/img]

[h1]Another round of performance optimization[/h1]
Improving performance across the board. This time the code that updates overlays has been improved. In my specific test case I went from aroung 20 FPS to a minimum of 120 FPS. I'm feeling pretty happy with that!

[h1]Pay bonuses to multiple employees[/h1]
By popular demand, you can now pay bonuses to multiple employees at once using the Employees Menu.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/40e19e27488aa4ac0694fd7f9e5d6c11707c5112.gif[/img]

Check out [url=https://ideas.startupcompanygame.com]our Conflux board[/url].[/code]

As always, we'll be monitoring the release very closely for any potential issues that might arise or that we might have missed during testing. If you encounter any issues or bugs, please send us a message in our Discord channel (link provided below) or create a post in the Steam discussions.

That's it for Beta 26!

Hi everyone,

Better late than never, but here it is: [b]Devlog number 50![/b]

[h1]Localizor has been updated and we need your votes![/h1]
We recently shipped a big update to Localizor, our community translation tool. We realized that having moderators for each language was a huge bottleneck. Instead, we made everyone a moderator by simply asking you to vote for the correct translations.

You can start voting right away: https://app.localizor.io/game/1/translations

As you go through the translations, you'll gain [b]1 point per vote[/b]. Later on you'll be able to convert these points into [b]exciting gifts[/b]. I can't show it just yet, but I'll promise it will be worth your time and effort :schappy:
[url=https://app.localizor.io/game/1/translations][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/d1179a6fe196bacbc001c4e5926c303b1a7b645b.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Outsourcing: Component/Module demand[/h1]
A new parameter has been added when bidding and receiving bids for outsourcing tasks: Demand. Next to each component/module you'll see a red, yellow or green indicator. Green means low market demand, red means high market demand. 

The higher the demand, the higher the price. Demands are dynamic and change based on the state of the game and how you play (or what tasks you create).
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/4b5312e50752613ac3fa162b36dff14a89f12ea3.jpg[/img]


[h1]Outsourcing: Market Prices[/h1]
A new tab has been added to the outsourcing menu, allowing you to see current prices and demands for components and modules. This view will allow you to make clever choices based on the demand and prices of specific components/modules.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/2339b616eef0e9c4f36c25123a5a3a869ae72dd5.jpg[/img]

[h1]Another round of performance optimization[/h1]
We've been working on improving performance. This time the code that update overlays has been improved. In my specific test case I went from ~20 fps to minimum 120 fps, so that's quite an improvement. 

iTzCallumUK's quote describes it too (the pause issue has also been fixed):

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/e5332feebe8557bbe0e404c45b4f305362c42057.jpg[/img]

[h1]Beta 26 ready yet?[/h1]
No, not yet. We still need to complete various things, such as:
[list]
[*] Testing and improving outsourcing for the later stages of the game.
[*] Added tool-tips and improved usability/UI for outsourcing.
[*] Translating new strings (they are not ready yet, I need to complete the tool-tips first).
[/list]

If everything goes well, my [i][b]guess[/b][/i] is that we're able to release the new update on August 16, 2019! :schappy:

That's all for this week.

All the best,

Jonas

[url=https://discord.gg/hovgaardgames]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/0c1ca7ac449e5f5cf87e27e7aa571c5c6a2f45d9.png[/img]

notes.title: Price increase to $12.99
notes.notes:
Hi there,

Today we're announcing that Startup Company will go slightly up in price, to reflect the long way we've come since we first released the game back in August 2017. 

Since the launch of the game we've been selling Startup Company for $9.99 (or your regional equivalent) and have been putting out countless updates, bug fixes, introduced new features and implemented requested gameplay features by the community. Since the official early access release back in 2017 we've updated the game at least ~80 times. 

On [b]July 19, 2019[/b] the price of Startup Company will be increased to $12.99. 

We wanted to communicate this to the community in advance, so that people who are considering to get Startup Company (or for their friends as a gift) have a chance to snatch it up for the ''old'' price. 

Does this mean that we're done with Startup Company? The short answer: [b]NO![/b] 

We've still got a lot of features planned for Startup Company and we're obviously going to listen closely to what the community wants as well. Startup Company will not leave the Early Access program of Steam just yet, as we want to make sure that potential players are still aware of the fact that we're still implementing new features which can sometimes result in massive gameplay overhauls. 

Feel free to join our Discord community (link provided below, just click the image) and we'll be happy to answer any questions you might have! 

All the best,

Jonas

notes.title: Beta 25 Released!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/x7Vnj64.png[/img]

Hi there!

[b]Beta 25 is now available. Restart Steam to get it right away![/b]

We're super excited to bring to you Beta 25, which will introduce new features that will change the game play and introduces new challenges for you to manage as CEO! 

[h1]Major change to website satisfaction: Dissatisfaction[/h1]
Beta 25 changes how website satisfaction is calculated.

[b]How it worked in Beta 24[/b]
The website satisfaction was calculated by simply using the average of all features' satisfaction. You could have a Landing Page with 100% satisfaction and "Banner Ads" with 15% satisfaction. This worked okay, but it was super confusing to new players, as the red smiley would show 5% for "video ads" and 15% for "banner ads", indicating that "video ads" would be less annoying to the user.

[b]How it now works in Beta 25[/b]
There are now two options for a feature: Satisfaction and Dissatisfaction. Base Features will only produce Satisfaction and Revenue Features will only produce Dissatisfaction.

The total website satisfaction is calculated by first taking the average of your base features and then subtracting the dissatisfaction from all the revenue features.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/abb262d2eba91b2c6c9df6f5b2bccae63c37f23f.jpg[/img]

Hopefully this change will make it more clear to new players how everything is calculated.

[i]Please notice: Existing Revenue features will continue to use the old model to avoid breaking your save-game. If you want to switch to the new model, you'll have to remove and add the revenue features.[/i]

[h1]AdBlockers[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/2f8a22fc2ab25d4a884134cb02b8a0241ad0b5cd.png[/img]
Adblockers are now a part of the game and will directly affect how many impressions is generated (and can be monetized) for ad features.

Small websites will have a very low ad-blocker penetration as they haven’t yet been discovered by many ad-blocker programs.

As a website gets more users, the more ad-blocker programs will register the site and start blocking ads.

[h1]AdBlock Obfuscator[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/31088a74ece430d2d22ec4b850cc484a2701c1a3.png[/img]
The obfuscator will cover up your ads in messy Javascript code that makes it much harder for the AdBlockers to detect your ads.

If you don’t continue upgrading the obfuscator, it will be less efficient over time (as AdBlockers become smarter).

The obfuscator is also the first time we see Research Points being used to upgrade a feature.

[code]Do you have suggestions or ideas for the game? 
Check out [url=https://ideas.startupcompanygame.com]our Conflux board[/url].[/code]

As always, we'll be monitoring the release very closely for any potential issues that might arise or that we might have missed during testing. If you encounter any issue or a bug, please send us a message in our Discord channel (link provided below) or create a post in our community hub - which we'll be closely monitoring while Beta 25  is rolled out. 

That's it for Beta 25!

Best,

Jonas

[/url]

Apologize for the silence lately. After Localizor was made public in Beta 24, there has been a substantiel increase in users interested in translating Startup Company into more languages.

Because of this interest, it has been necessary to improve various parts of system which has been taking up my time. Fortunately I'm almost done, and looking at the numbers it looks like we'll soon see both Dutch and Polish added to the game. Thank you to everyone who has contributed! :schappy:

[h1]Major change to website satisfaction: Dissatisfaction[/h1]
Beta 25 will now completely change how website satisfaction is calculated.

[b]How it works today[/b]
Today the website satisfaction is calculated by simply using the average of all features' satisfaction. You could have a Landing Page with 100% satisfaction and "Banner Ads" with 15% satisfaction. This worked okay, but it was super confusing to new players, as the red smiley would show 5% for "video ads" and 15% for "banner ads", indicating that "video ads" would be less annoying to the user.

[b]How it works in Beta 25[/b]
In the future there will instead be two options for a feature: Satisfaction and Dissatisfaction. Base Features will only produce Satisfaction and Revenue Features will only produce Dissatisfaction.

The total website satisfaction is calculated by first taking the average of your base features and then subtracting the dissatisfaction from all the revenue features.

[i]Please notice: Existing Revenue features will continue to use the old model to avoid breaking your savegame. If you want to switch to the new model, you'll have to remove and add the revenue features.[/i]

[h1]Outsourcing[/h1]
By popular demand I'm now introducing Outsourcing in Startup Company. We had the feature in the game before (formerly known as “Contract Work”).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/54fc149f4647b1ba50619d99c2d989dc301e5955.png[/img]

To start finding outsourcing tasks you have to hire and use a Sales Executive. It will take between 4 and 24 hours to find a new task.

A task contains the following properties:
Requirements - The components and modules that has to be delivered.
Time Left - The amount of hours before the bidding ends.
Deadline - The amount of days before the requirements has to be delivered (after “time left” and bidding has ended).
Current Bid - The current lowest price.

Another new thing about Outsourcing is that you’ll also be able to [b]submit your own tasks and have your competitors work for you![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/2a49f4044aa4f7202c63c0d2454d21a1b9297936.png[/img]

Check out [url=https://ideas.startupcompanygame.com]our Conflux board[/url].[/code]

Yea, I really don't know for sure, but let me explain what we're waiting for:

[b]Beta 25:[/b] Everything is done. We're testing right now. Strings has been uploaded to Localizor. Once everything is translated and bug free, I'll release it. My hope is Friday (June 28).

[b]Beta 26:[/b] Development has started. Together with Outsourcing I also want to include a bunch of additional QOL improvements. We're probably looking at late July.

[h1]That's all for this week![/h1]
I hope the changes above is as exciting for you as it is for me. I can't wait to ship it all to you :schappy:

By the way, stay tuned for next week. [b]I got some major news to announce![/b]

All the best,

Another huge performance improvement hits Startup Company. This time I've been working heavily on improving performance of the employee overlays which caused a lot of end-game lag.

notes.title: Devlog #42
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

In this week I have mainly been working on the new help system in Startup Company (which is incredible time consuming task to create). I've found some time to ship a couple of hotfixes for Beta 22 as well. (see #news on our Discord server.)

[h1]Help System[/h1]
The new help system will be introduced in Beta 23. The system will help you understand every aspect of Startup Company, this is especially interesting for new players. 

The system will first be introduced in English only. Once we're sure everything is covered, I'll have to translated later to the other languages.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/f1fc283e8a7308585cc597523a3500913abfc1c8.gif[/img]

[i]All the notes that are listed above are simply a preview of what's coming up in Startup Company. These new changes and items are not yet available in the public build of the game.[/i]

[h1]Updated Roadmap[/h1]
The roadmap has been updated to represent my current expectations.
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/d5d3b011584a012146eb2b134c42bc16a418a9fc.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/68729533bbb90b9ff01a938c6716d756b1578870.png[/img][/url]
[b]Click the thumbnail to see full size.[/b]

[h1]Leaving Early Access[/h1]
It's already been 1½ years since Startup Company was released in Early Access on Steam. The game has been undergoing huge changes and is now in a much more stable and accessible state than when it was released.

We feel confident that with the release of Beta 23 the quality of the game is suitable to leave Early Access and become a full release. An official full release date is yet to be determined.

So does this mean development of Startup Company will stop? [b]Absolutely not[/b]. We just want to stop sending the signal to new players that the game is a buggy and bad experience, because we really think it's not.

I will still continue to follow the roadmap and release new features after the full release.

[h1]How do you feel about a paid DLC?[/h1]
As most of you know, all development of Startup Company is done by me (Jonas). This is great as it keeps expenses down, but it also slows down how often new features can be introduced and how big they can be.

This is why I want to ask how you feel about a DLC. My idea is that the income from the DLC covers the expenses of hiring another developer who could work exclusively on new content.

As always, you guys, the community, comes first. So please let me know what you think. Should I drop the idea and just continue working solo or would you gladly pay for a DLC in order to get more content faster? All feedback is very much appreciated!

[code]Do you have suggestions or ideas for the game? 
Check out [url=https://ideas.startupcompanygame.com]our Conflux board[/url].[/code]

That's it for this week! 

Best,

Jonas & Robert

notes.title: Beta 22 Released!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/5af382a9260d145de6ac43405c20adc5512a8358.png[/img]

Hi there! 

[b]Beta 22 is now available. Restart Steam to get it right away![/b]

Beta 22 introduces quite a big list of new features, changes and improvements to the game. We're very excited to see how all our players will adapt their companies to these changes and how new companies will use them to prosper! We're very eager to share this all with you! 

As with each Beta release we just want to make sure that you’re aware of the fact that there might be some bugs or other unexpected issues. Jonas is on standby, ready to make sure that any discovered issues are fixed as soon as possible. If you find any bugs or experience any issues make sure to either let us know on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/606800/discussions/]community hub[/url] or by joining our [url=https://discord.gg/hovgaardgames]Discord![/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/4a57c036ee8f64b6fa543caa6ad7084bb8dc6292.png[/img]

[h1]New office building[/h1]
After enormous demand from you guys, it's finally time to introduce the new office building. You get 2 floors and an 400 employees high limitation. Enjoy!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/8d1ad7cf1df00c114bd64badfd9202e1cfe9bc43.png[/img]

[h1]Improvements to Sales Executives/Leads[/h1]
Beta 22 introduces two big changes to the Sales Executive: First, the maximum amount of leads has been increased. For individual Sales Executives the numbers will be:
[table]
 [tr] [td]Beginner[/td][td]3[/td] [/tr]
 [tr] [td]Intermediate[/td][td]6[/td] [/tr]
 [tr] [td]Expert[/td][td]9[/td] [/tr]
[/table]

However, if you choose to team up multiple Sales Executives using a Manager, [b]you'll be able to share leads between your executives![/b] The lead limits for teams will be slight lowered like so:
[table]
 [tr] [td]Beginner Manager[/td][td]9[/td] [/tr]
 [tr] [td]Intermediate Manager[/td][td]18[/td] [/tr]
 [tr] [td]Expert Manager[/td][td]27[/td] [/tr]
[/table]

The second exciting update to the Sales Executive is [b]filters[/b]. You'll now be able to choose the minimum and maximum impressions you're looking for. No more rejecting offers because the impressions don't fit your time-slot. This has been heavily requested by the community. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/0f0ec3999475dccb402b9d43f43537f0a6dffe65.gif[/img]

[h1]Manual Saving[/h1]
Startup Company has always been using auto-save for handling savegames. This is convenient as players don't have to remember to save. However, with a tycoon game like Startup Company, you sometimes want to try things out without having to start over if it goes wrong.

Beta 22 introduces manual save functionality. You'll now have to save your game manually and choose a name for your savegame (basically "slots" as you know it from other games). The game will still auto-save (now every 5 minutes), but instead, save to a new "hidden" savegame and not overwrite your existing savegames. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/9ca5f5699f73e6757d5fbf4f1fc6c590081bdbea.gif[/img]

[h1]Website Logo and Name[/h1]
Beta 22 includes another highly demanded feature: Changing your website's name and selecting a logo.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/1b627edfdc77cebef0739961189de79d87ce4c75.gif[/img]

[h1]Improved Employees Menu[/h1]
I've been able to put some hours into the Employees Menu. For a long time, it has been missing a "multi-employee actions" feature. The list was also incredibly laggy later on in the game.

The new menu introduces a couple of new features:
[list]
[*] Added icon next to speed to show if the employee is ready to be upgraded.
[*] Show if an employee is unseated.
[*] Remember the selected sorting order when re-opening the menu.
[*] Added mass action functionality allowing you to apply the following actions to multiple employees at once: remove from desk, fire, send home (1/3 days), start/stop training and release from manager.
[*] Greatly improved performance and removing lag when having more than 200 employees.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/3cd32686c4fd8949df05628ac63dd262c8f273cd.gif[/img]

[h1]Employee Switcher[/h1]
A brand new "Employee Switcher" will also be introduced in Beta 22. It will allow you to quickly cycle through your employees. [b]The switcher will follow the order of your Employees Menu[/b] allowing you to customize the sorting.

When changing employee, the switcher will automatically stay on the same tab if it's available for the employee type.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/5c84d3fbe8d4c8be7c99fc0065079172d9e2059e.gif[/img]

[h1]Paying a Bonus[/h1]
Beta 22 offers you the ability to pay your employees bonuses. Paying a bonus will instantly increase your employee's mood to 100%. The price is based on a combination of the employee's salary and their current mood.

The bonus is meant as an alternative to sending your employees home in order to restore mood. Once a bonus has been paid you'll have to wait 30 in-game days before paying another bonus.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/88329e2ce6b57ba013fe551ecf2b0ee15f93c7e3.jpg[/img]

[h1]Ad Contracts Daily Payment[/h1]
The number one question asked since Ad Contracts were introduced has been "Why do I lose money when the finance overview says I earn money every day?". Most players never noticed that contracts were paid upfront and if you had a contract running for 7 days (for example) it would mean you'll have 6 days with no payments.

Beta 22 changed this and instead made payments happen daily.

[i]I personally wasn't too happy with this change, as I liked the realism of having to take into consideration when contracts were paid out (I know a few of you agree with me). However, the frustration and confusion for new players simply wasn't worth it.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/284dfc075d5f324ccb1e3c4b2d997e50708fe485.jpg[/img]

[h1]Scheduled Training Days[/h1]
HR Managers will be updated too. Scheduled training days work identically with "Days Off" by simply allowing you to define weekdays in which the employee should train.

Once an employee starts a training day this cannot be cancelled (same with days off). "Days Off" and ''Training Days'' cannot be scheduled to the same weekdays (obviously).

Limitations have also been added: Setting "days off" requires an Intermediate Level. Setting "Training Days" requires an Expert level.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/fa8260368e26ed35a48b9f0865cae576484230fc.jpg[/img]

[h1]Improved Queue System[/h1]
The current production system for developers, designers, etc. allows you to switch between the Repeat and Queue functionality. In Beta 22 those two functionalities are combined into one: an ''Infinite Repeating Queue''. The queue size has also been increased to 10. 

Components will remain in the queue after they have been produced. The blue background indicates which component is currently in development.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/47c402100580e0903bfa6b80a24adcce584e0ee3.gif[/img]

[h1]Updated employee demands[/h1]
[list]
[*] "Fire Employee" is now rarer and will only occur for existing employees, and not new candidates.
[*] Employees' demands are now more realistic, especially with desks, including demanding the correct Programmer/Executive desk at Expert level.
[*] Differ the number of new demands generated on employee upgrade based on level.
[/list]

[h1]New loans[/h1]
Beta 22 brings two new loans allowing you to loan 1 and 2 million. Loans will only be available if you meet the minimum company valuation (valuation of all websites combined). Fever Inc (the 600k loan) has also been limited to companies with a minimum valuation of 1.2 million.

[h1]Last chance before bankruptcy[/h1]
I've added an additional mechanic which gives the player a last chance before the company is declared bankrupt. The offer only comes if the player owns more than 15% of his website, hasn't bought out the investor and no loan options are available in the banks.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/846bfbf3076193be6f5eb0da32aaccdfdfa6bbed.jpg[/img]

[h1]Improved hosting stats[/h1]
The stats in the bottom of the hosting centre has been improved to support larger numbers. A "bottleneck alert" has also been added to make it easier to understand what to increase in order to increase produced CU.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/319d5ec1aa1384f404b0d4495515939431dbf267.jpg[/img]

[h1]Furniture/desk inventory[/h1]
When removing furniture and desks from your office they will now be added to your "purchase inventory", allowing you to save items for later use.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/d71c1f0545514bd0247c0bcb8a2f9c284e2b6555.png[/img]

[h1]Improved UI for placing unassigned employees[/h1]
Beta 22 makes it much easier to find the right employee when you have a lot of unassigned employees. The new table allows sorting and introduces a "Hired" column, making it easy to find the newly hired employee.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/f772d7090dec9875a0175c6a5e453cc4be588c2d.jpg[/img]

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
We made a lot of minor changes as well, which are outlined in the bulleted overview below:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug causing employee not to quit if ignoring competitor offer.
[*] Fixed bug causing employees with missing requirements not showing as flashing overlay.
[*] Fixed two memory leaks causing lag in late-game.
[*] Fixed bug causing merging competitors to fail or end prematurely.
[*] Fixed bug causing events to be launched too early (at game start)
[*] Fixed bug causing hosting building temperature not to update correctly.
[*] Fixed bug causing employee name changes not to update on overlays.
[*] Added support for panning using arrow keys.
[*] Added PageUp/PageDown keyboard shortcut for changing floor.
[*] Added Q/E keyboard shortcut to toggle between employees (switcher).
[*] Improved sliders when buying/selling competitor stocks.
[*] Added time limitation to investment offers.
[*] Limited feature efficiency from a maximum of 104% to a maximum of 100% (only affects new savegames, not existing ones).
[*] Changed overlay label to "At home" when not at the office.
[*] Added "sell" feature to rack devices
[*] Added the new 6-frame hand animations.
[*] Suppressed "office upgrade"-confirmation when renting the very first office.
[*] Show relevant Research category when clicking on "Research more" tips.
[*] Added hovering + sorting to Manager's employee list.
[*] Improved UI of rack stats and (mass)configure view.
[*] Added localisation for watt, kilowatt and megawatt.
[*] Added popup to the rack's Add Device view, allowing you to see throughput and size before buying.
[*] Added warning when trying to add a device to a rack with no space left.
[*] Added tooltip explaining manager bonus. Lowered the bonus when a manager isn't at the office.
[*] Improved demands view in employees' stats menu.
[*] Allowed employees to demand for "Coffee Machine" to be fulfilled by "Industrial Coffee Machine"
[*] Features' level marked with blue if at framework's maximum.
[*] Changed "Sell Out" achievement percentage from 10% to 50%.
[*] Fixed bug causing duplicated "Fire co-worker" demand.
[*] Stopped action-depending events from firing when the time machine is active.
[*] Changed the minimum marketing campaign conversion rate from 0% to 1%.
[*] Improved UI of "change desk" view.
[*] Added "Go to Manager" button to all employees.
[/list]

As always, we're dedicated to making sure everything runs smoothly by fixing potential issues, listening to the community and continuing the development by working towards Beta 23.

Check out [url=https://ideas.startupcompanygame.com]our Conflux board[/url].[/code]

All the best,
Jonas & Robert

notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

This update is similar to the update of last week, I've been working around the clock to get as many "Quality of Life" improvements and fixes ready for Beta 22. I'm close to "feature locking", which means testing (which will be very intensive this time) and translation of the new strings in Beta 22.

[h1]Centralized Clockrate Controller V2[/h1]
After the first version of the CCC was released I noticed very few players used the "rules feature". Although I still continued to get the question "What can I do against DDoS attacks?".

What I learned was that the current CCC simply was too complicated for most players. Very few players fully understood the activation and deactivation functionality and thereby avoided using it at all.

To fix this, Beta 22 will introduce a greatly simplified CCC. You no longer define activation and deactivation percentages, but instead simply set the clock rate you want the racks to switch to in case of a DDoS attack or a viral boost. 

I hope this makes the CCC easier to use and easier to understand.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/e8ad67dfba784b29dbdd9ebd6e014576085fb935.jpg[/img]

I've been able to put some hours into the Employees Menu. For a long time it has been missing a "multi employee actions" feature. The list was also incredible laggy late game.

The new menu introduces a couple of new features:
[list]
[*] Added icon next to speed to show if the employee is ready to be upgraded.
[*] Show if an employee is unseated.
[*] Remember the selected sorting order when re-opening the menu.
[*] Added mass action functionality allowing you to apply the following actions to multiple employees at once: remove from desk, fire, send home (1/3 days), start/stop training and release from manager.
[*] Greatly improved performance and removing lag when having more than 200 employees.
[/list]

notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

This week I've been working exclusively on Beta 22. It's been very different compared to the last 6 months of development, as the only new feature of Beta 22 is the bigger office (called Headquarter). Instead Beta 22 introduces tons of improvements and fixes to existing features, all requested by the community (you guys).

[h1]Improvements to Sales Executives/Leads[/h1]
Beta 22 will introduce two big changes to the Sales Executive: First, the maximum amount of leads are being increased. For individual Sales Executives the numbers will be:
[table]
 [tr] [td]Beginner[/td][td]3[/td] [/tr]
 [tr] [td]Intermediate[/td][td]6[/td] [/tr]
 [tr] [td]Expert[/td][td]9[/td] [/tr]
[/table]

However, if you choose to team up multiple Sales Executives using a Manager, [b]you'll be able to share leads between your executives![/b] The lead limits for teams will be a bit decrease:
[table]
 [tr] [td]Beginner Manager[/td][td]9[/td] [/tr]
 [tr] [td]Intermediate Manager[/td][td]18[/td] [/tr]
 [tr] [td]Expert Manager[/td][td]27[/td] [/tr]
[/table]

The second exciting update to the Sales Executive is [b]filters[/b]. You'll now be able to choose the minimum and maximum impressions you're looking for. No more rejecting offers because the impressions doesn't fit your timeslot. This has been heavily requested by the community. I hope you all like it! :-)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/0f0ec3999475dccb402b9d43f43537f0a6dffe65.gif[/img]

Startup Company has always been using auto-save for handling savegames. This is convenient as players doesn't have to remember to save. However, with a tycoon game like Startup Company, you sometimes want to try things out without having to start over if it goes wrong.

Beta 22 will introduce manual save functionality. You'll now have to save your game manually and choose a name for your savegame (basically "slots" as you know it from other games). The game will still auto-save (now every 5 minutes), but instead save to a new "hidden" savegame and not overwrite your existing savegames.
