notes.title: Beta 21 Released!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/2d56bb70bab1ca91851d36b1211bf8b56eac159c.png[/img]

Hi there! 

[b]Beta 21 is now available. Restart Steam to get it right away![/b]

We’ve just launched Beta 21 after extensive testing and made it available for everyone! Beta 21 is an exciting Beta version as it adds a lot of new features that add a whole new dynamic to the game, including features that were highly requested by players in our community. 

As with each Beta release we just want to make sure that you’re aware of the fact that there might be some bugs or other unexpected issues. Jonas is standing by to make sure anything that might go wrong will get "hotfixed" as soon as possible. If you find any bugs or experience any issues make sure to either let us know on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/606800/discussions/]community hub[/url] or by joining our [url=https://discord.gg/hovgaardgames]Discord![/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/4a57c036ee8f64b6fa543caa6ad7084bb8dc6292.png[/img]

[h1]Support Tickets[/h1]
We’ve now successfully added support tickets to Beta 21. These are basically questions and issues coming from your users that you will have to handle. It adds a whole new dynamic to Startup Company where you have to make sure that your users will be happy with the support that you provide them.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/c9bd4dd3c2abe04bd9812f1a0eb551a9a64ddcf7.jpg[/img]

Tickets has to be handled within 36 hours. Anything later than that will decrease your [b]Support Satisfaction.[/b]

[h1]Support Team[/h1]
Tickets come in 3 different complexities (difficulties): low, medium and high complexity. To solve them, you have to hire new employees for a brand new role: [b]Supporter.[/b]

As with any other employee type the Supporter comes with various degrees of experience such as Beginners, Intermediates and Experts.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/7f66507a7d2bd89c0b3aa3e616facf666e2705b2.jpg[/img] 

All Supporters resolve tickets at the same speed (relatively to their own speed of course), but Intermediate and Expert Supporters will eventually become unhappy if they're forced to solve too many tickets below their level of expertise.

[h1]Support Dissatisfaction[/h1]
If you fail to handle support tickets in time, it will directly impact your website's overall satisfaction. 

The support dissatisfaction is working a bit different from Features as the decrease is subtracted directly from the subtotal of your current website satisfaction.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/0ed9a2174cdd72528edeb19fb7967f94fd9ff81b.jpg[/img]

[h1]Recruiters and Headhunting[/h1]
Beta 21 will introduce a revised recruitment functionality. You'll now have to use a "Recruiter" (or your CEO) in order to find and headhunt new employees. 

You'll be able to poach (better known as steal) employees from your competitors and negotiate salaries and signing bonus in order to persuade them to take you up on your offer. 

The new feature also allows you to research the candidates demands.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/ed92bf86bb71f0c90375c10c1a837b17f5597255.gif[/img] 

[h1]The CEO[/h1]
A highly requested and popular demand of the community was the ability to add the CEO to the game. Beta 21 will deliver on that promise and will allow you to introduce "yourself" to the game as the CEO (Chief Executive Officer). 

The first time you launch Beta 21 you will be required to customize your CEO. All CEOs will have a personal "bonus" that affects the rest of the game (see screenshot for more details). 

The CEO will act identically with the new "Recruiter" employee type, however uniquely for the CEO he won't require a salary or age at all (I know, it's unrealistic, but imagine the Steam reviews if I retire the player themselves).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/78d2c33fccc30092f0dba1a0cf1befa3270f1ca5.jpg[/img] 

[h1]Age & Retirement[/h1]
A new and very important feature will be added to all employees: age. As time goes by, your employees will start to age. It won't affect performance (mood or speed), but once the employee reaches the age of 65 he/she will retire.

[b]Note: All employees from existing save games will be set to an age between 25 and 30 years old.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/07a02fc8476f3e51b6a48e30848a3c9dd9cbe253.jpg[/img]

notes.notes:
Hi all! 

Last week we made some exciting announcements regarding the new features that will be available in Beta 21. A highly requested community feature was the ability to set up a customer service / support department, which will be making it's way into the game. This won't be the only exciting new feature for Beta 21, as we're planning to reveal a bunch more in this Devlog! 

You can click [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/606800/announcements/detail/3342135027704173941]here[/url] to read the previous Devlog in which we also unveiled cool features for Beta 21.  

[h1]Recruiters and Headhunting[/h1]
Beta 21 will introduce a revised recruitment functionality. You'll now have to use a "Recruiter" (or your CEO) in order to find and headhunt new employees.

You'll be able to poach (better known as steal) employees from your competitors and negotiate salaries and signing bonus in order to persuade them to take you up on your offer. 

The new feature also allows you to research the candidates demands.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/ed92bf86bb71f0c90375c10c1a837b17f5597255.gif[/img]

[h1]Age & Retirement[/h1]
A new and very important feature will be added to all employees: age. As time goes by, your employees will start to age. It won't affect performance (mood or speed), but once the employee reaches the age of 65 he/she will retire.

[b]Note: All employees from existing save games will be set to the age of 25.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/07a02fc8476f3e51b6a48e30848a3c9dd9cbe253.jpg[/img]

[h1]The CEO[/h1]
A highly requested and popular demand of the community was the ability to add the CEO to the game. Beta 21 will deliver on that promise and will allow you to introduce "yourself" to the game as the CEO (Chief Executive Officer).

The first time you launch Beta 21 you will be required to customize your CEO. All CEOs will have a personal "bonus" that affects the rest of the game (see screenshot for more details).

The CEO will act identically with the new "Recruiter" employee type, however uniquely for the CEO he won't require a salary or age at all (I know, it's unrealistic, but imagine the Steam reviews if I retire the player themselves).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/78d2c33fccc30092f0dba1a0cf1befa3270f1ca5.jpg[/img]

[h1]Progress of Beta 21[/h1]
Right now we're super busy fixing bugs and testing out the new features. They still need a lot balancing. The new office building is also in the making (we hope to be able to present it in next week's Devlog).

Finally everything needs to be translated and tested on all platforms. You should expect a release in 2-3 weeks if everything goes well :-)

Hello everyone! 

This week is an exciting week for us, as we're going to share some of features with you, which are planned for Beta 21. 

It's always very interesting for us to implement new features and to see how the players will be managing and coming up with ingenious methods on optimizing everything. These new features will effect gameplay up to a certain degree where you'll have to manage another aspect in your Startup Company! 

[h1]Support Tickets[/h1]
Beta 21 will introduce support tickets. These are basically questions and issues coming from your users that you will have to handle. It adds a whole new dynamic to Startup Company where you have to make sure that your users will be happy with the support that you provide them. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/c9bd4dd3c2abe04bd9812f1a0eb551a9a64ddcf7.jpg[/img]

Tickets has to be handled within 36 hours. Anything later than that will decrease your [b]Support Satisfaction[/b].

[h1]Support Teams[/h1]
Tickets come in 3 different complexities (difficulties): low, medium and high complexity. To solve them, you have to hire new employees for a brand new role: [b]Supporter[/b]. 

As with any other employee type the Supporter comes with various degrees of experience such as Beginners, Intermediates and Experts. 

However, unlike the other "production" employees the Supporters should be paired with matching ticket complexity. For example: Expert Supporters will be slower at resolving low complexity tickets than Beginner Supporters.

To overcome this challenge, you'll be able to set up Support Teams which will limit its members (employees) to the selected complexities.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/7f66507a7d2bd89c0b3aa3e616facf666e2705b2.jpg[/img]

[h1]Support Dissatisfaction[/h1]
If you fail to handle support tickets in time, it will directly impact your website's overall satisfaction. 

The support dissatisfaction is working a bit different from [i]Features[/i] as the decrease is subtracted directly from the subtotal of your current website satisfaction.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/0ed9a2174cdd72528edeb19fb7967f94fd9ff81b.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone! 

[b]Beta 20 is now available. Restart Steam to get it right away![/b]

It’s official, Beta 20 is the first Beta to hit in the year 2019! Because Beta 19 was heavily focused on optimization for the future of Startup Company we were able to add lots of cool new features for everyone to explore in the current Beta. In 2019 we’ll continue our promise to listen to ideas and feedback from the community! 

With each Beta release we just want to make sure that you’re aware of the fact that there might be some bugs. Jonas is standing by to make sure anything that might go wrong will get "hotfixed" as soon as possible.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/4a57c036ee8f64b6fa543caa6ad7084bb8dc6292.png[/img]

[h1]Research Tree[/h1]
The new Research Tree is replacing the current tier system and is now live in Beta 20. You will be able to unlock exactly what you want. This means that you don't have to wait anymore for tiers to unlock, you're now completely in control. 

All the features of Startup Company are unlocked via the Research Tree and not only items that used to be limited by old tier system.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/046c31916085ed1f5083118bdaff26ade6bdf0a5.gif[/img]

[i]Note: If you were higher than Tier 5 you will get 2.000 Research Points (RP) when you're upgrading to Beta 20.[/i]

[h1]Centralized Clockrate Controller (CCC)[/h1]
We’ve implemented the Centralized Clockrate Controller (CCC) in Startup Company, which is a highly requested feature by our community. 

This new unit can control the clockrate for up to 500 servers. A practical example would be: if you reach 90% overall CU usage, the CCC will change the clockrate from 50% to 100%. We're looking forward to see how everyone will make use of this new feature! 

Together with the new and improved XServers you'll now be able to ensure your company is ready for the future - especially when you're being DDoS'd or get a viral boost!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/f76db6720f4da69a8d0b4a63f3ef88d57e7fdf92.png[/img]

[h1]XServers[/h1]
With the release of Beta 20 two new server types are now available: the Small and the Large XServer. These new servers are a lot bigger compared to the existing servers. The servers also generates a lot of heat and a higher energy consumption per throughput. The XServers are a great choice to combine with the CCC to keep expenses low, while still having the power to overcome increased traffic.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/2486b0ca8cf464289001d486405228c2ece27c7e.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/e3924b672cb7cbcda7fb3df2c31da7f522bbab2d.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Development Recap 2018
notes.notes:
[h1]Recap - Startup Company 2018[/h1]

Wow! I don’t think words can describe how amazing this year has been for us. We celebrated our one year anniversary (in August 2018), added tons of new features, fixed bugs, built up an even bigger community and also set some clear indicators as to where we want to take Startup Company in 2019.

In this post, we wanted to look back at the year and see what new features we added, what mechanics completely changed the game and also tell you about our plans for Startup Company in 2019.

[h1]Beta 14 in February 2018[/h1]
We started the year strong with Beta 14 which added tons of new features. Some of them are no longer in the current version but features such as the tracking stock prices, the activity log and product functionality are still present in the game.

After Beta 14 there were many changes and fixes that Jonas worked on within the timespan of a few days, a promise that he’s dedicated on keeping. Once all the bugs were fixed it was time to move onto Beta 15.

[h1]Beta 15 drops on April 12, 2018[/h1]
Beta 15 revolved around adding more personality to the game, giving it a stronger startup-feel and focusing more on the new players. The game became a lot more appealing and user-friendly, which was something that we noticed in the comments on the forums and Discord at that time.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/90d5d1e6bc0c64e3e345810df28386a6507baa7a.jpg[/img]

We simplified the infrastructure tab and changed a lot of wording to make everything more clear. We also fixed a [b]LOT[/b] of issues and bugs that we had back in that period, making the game a lot more stable and fun to play.

[h1]74 days later, Beta 16 releases[/h1]
On June 25, 2018 we released Beta 16. It had been a while since Startup Company had seen any big updates on the default branch where the majority of the players are playing from. For Jonas it was the biggest update he worked on. So as you can imagine, he was very proud of that achievement!

Beta 16 completely rewrote how the hosting functionality worked by introducing the hosting buildings. We not only added the buildings, but we also added the functionality for racks and servers.

Jonas also needed a new and more immersive way to display all these new buildings. That is how the ‘City Map’ was born:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/03d0b9978c30232d797c1fcd492d350abc20e37e.png[/img] 

Other things such as acquiring competitors, receiving investment offers, milestones and a bunch of fixes were also introduced in Beta 16. This Beta version was incredibly big compared to all the previous ones!

[h1]Beta 17 just after the anniversary![/h1]
Just 13 days after we celebrated the first year anniversary (release on Steam) Jonas launched Beta 17 for everyone on the default branch. Beta 17 added the most complicated mechanics ever seen in the game, and he was very nervous (but also excited) on getting feedback from all the players. 

The marketing functionality had been completely rewritten. You no longer had to constantly restart campaigns. Instead, Jonas was inspired by the real world, where your campaign’s success will be based on your ability to correctly target the relevant audience.

Beta 17 also introduces a new variable to your products: Satisfaction. You’ll now have to improve features based on user feedback.

Maybe the most significant change has been that Jonas changed how Features for your product worked. Features of your product are no longer just for increasing your “potential users”. They are now also for creating new revenue channels. You’ll be able to choose between Text Ads, Banner Ads, Video Ads and Subscriptions. Basically you started earning money from selling ads and no longer from completing contracts, which was removed completely. This might have been the most discussed change by the community we’ve ever had! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GAXMRUc.gif[/img]

[h1]Beta 18 releases in October 2018[/h1]
Releasing new features is always exciting, as players get to experience the game on a whole new level. It’s especially exciting when we’re introducing features that are requested by actual players, so we’re always keen to receive feedback so that we can further improve Startup Company and make it as fun as possible! Beta 18 was such an update. We introduced the highly requested queue feature, making the early game less of a chore. We also implemented lots of handy features such as the contract expiration bar, random events (DDoS attacks), viral boosts and more. 

Beta 18, for the first time ever in Startup Company, allowed you to ‘’beat’’ the game. Once you've completed everything there is to do in Startup Company you will now be awarded a high-score, which lets you measure yourself up against other CEOs playing the game!

[h1]Improving the performance of Startup Company[/h1]
Beta 19 released earlier this month and was focused on improving a lot of stuff that will prepare Startup Company for 2019. You can now employ a lot more employees (from 180 to 260) and this limit will be increased in the future.

We also added some new overlays, improved the clickable area and added a bunch of new items to decorate your office with. You can read all about it in our Beta 18 release on Steam [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/606800/announcements/detail/1711828601511634979]here.[/url]

[h1]2019, the year of Startup Company![/h1]
We can’t wait for 2019 to start. We’re going continue developing Startup Company according to our [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/a11956ef26063a1354d5ea347f9d12b5a3961845.png]updated roadmap from December 7, 2018[/url] but also include highly requested features/fixes from our players.

We’re currently working very hard on Beta 20, which will introduce a Research Tree, new X Servers (more info about it in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/606800/announcements/detail/1710701432500663097]Devlog 32[/url]) and various UI optimizations. We hope to ship this update to everyone as soon as possible.

In the future we’re going to add a bunch of new features such as:

- Website Support. You will have to manage customer service and handle complains/questions from your customers.
- A new hiring system that will allow interviews, negotiations and more. 
-Addition of CEO to the office
- UI and QOL Overhaul. Everything will be improved with a focus on usability and “quality of life.
- In-game help system. Helping new players find their way around the game more easily.

[code]Do you have suggestions or ideas for the game? Check out [url=https://ideas.startupcompanygame.com]our Conflux board[/url].[/code]

We wish you all a Happy New Year and we’re looking forward to bringing you more amazing updates for Startup Company in 2019!

All the best,

Jonas & Robert 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/606800/Startup_Company/

[h1]Performance Improvements[/h1]
Since the Early Access release Startup Company hasn't been the most optimized game and everyone who had 180 employees know what we're talking about. 

The main reason for the bad performance has always been the way the office was rendered (DOM elements). This was a decision we took early on, as Startup Company at the time wasn't that "big" of a game. People usually had 10-20 employees.

Now as the  game has progressed, it's time to move on to WebGL and something called canvas. This is all geek talk, but what it really means is the game is going to be incredible efficient compared to the latest Beta 18.

Here's some early stats showing the improvements (all based on i7 7700K and a GTX1060):

[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Test[/th]

        [th]Beta 19[/th]
    [/tr]

        [td]144 fps[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]

        [td]144 fps[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]150x150 office with 400 employees[/td]
        [td]Unable to load[/td]
        [td]102 fps[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[h1]More employees in the Skyscraper[/h1]
The maximum desks in the skyscraper has been increased from 180 to 260. We plan on increasing the limit even more, as more performance improvements gets introduced in the future.

[h1]New desks[/h1]
We’ve added two new desks to the game, one that is perfect for managers and one that grants your programmers, SysAdmins and designers an amazing setup! Here are the images of these setups: 

[b]The executive setup[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/17e74f31a42ec294b67cb08532509ebbc49bad55.png[/img]

[b]The ultimate setup[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/9445ae81c44190eddc3c8c864fb7a18b582e3f4b.png[/img]

[h1]New overlays[/h1]
We’ve included new overlays which shows a lot more information in a much cleaner way!  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/077d9be4e34603ea5a102a55c579cafdbf42c575.png[/img]


[h1]Improved-Clickable-Area[/h1]
It has been a pain to move certain items, especially when you had a bigger office with more items in there. We've now significantly improved the clickable area from where you can select items that you previously placed on the office floor. This will allow you to remove and/or change items in your office a lot easier. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/b1448a946709ffc5f5d5e8c4a3b9f011800ab313.gif[/img]

[h1]New location for Mods[/h1]
The location where mods are stored has been changed. In addition to that, when you’re upgrading to a newer version of Startup Company mods will automatically deactivate. You will need to manually enable them again in the mods section in the game itself. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/04c45e548dd7c0724e1aa4dc86a016616f077c47.png[/img]

[h1]FAQ about Beta 19[/h1]
[i]Beta 19 feels much slower than Beta 18. Shouldn’t it be faster?[/i]
This can be the case if your setup is below our minimum requirements. Beta 18 was relying mainly on the CPU. Beta 19 is different and is now utilizing the GPU instead. Make sure to play the game with a dedicated graphics card.

[i]Is there a way to upgrade existing racks to the new 42U rack?[/i]
Unfortunately not at this time. It’s on our radar, together with a ton of other features.

[i]The toggle overlay and the new desks are missing translations. Is this intended?[/i]
Yes, as Beta 19 almost contained no new translations, we have postponed translation of some strings until Beta 20.

As always, we're dedicated to make sure everything runs smoothly by fixing potential issues, listening to the community and continue the development by working towards Beta 20. In case you're wondering what's coming up in Beta 20 make sure to take a look at [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/a11956ef26063a1354d5ea347f9d12b5a3961845.png]our updated roadmap from December 7, 2018.[/url]

Check out [url=https://ideas.startupcompanygame.com]our Conflux board[/url].[/code]

Best,
Jonas & Robert

notes.title: Devlog #32
notes.notes:
Hi there! 

Hope ya'll had a great Thanksgiving. This week we've got some cool news regarding Beta 19, as you're now able to join the fun! Usually we post our Devlogs on Sundays, but we had some unforeseen issues yesterday that prevented us from posting the Devlog. We're also going to show a new feature that will be added for Beta 20 in this Devlog too! 

[h1]Beta 19 is on the beta-branch[/h1]
Beta 19 is focused on optimization and making sure that people who reached the end-game can continue growing their company with even more employees and bigger offices! Make sure to check out some of the previous Devlogs that cover some other features and optimizations that will be present in the new Beta version of Startup Company. 

You can now join the fun yourself, as we've published Beta 19 on the testing branch. Below we've listed the steps that you need to complete in order to get on the Beta 19 branch. 

- Go to your Steam library. 
- Right click on Startup Company and select ''Properties''
- Go to the ''BETAS''-tab. 
- Enter the password: ''startupcompany19'' to unlock the branch
- Select ''beta 19'' from the drop-down menu. 
- Close the window and you should automatically download Beta 19. 

[b]Please note[/b]: Beta 19 is still very unstable, which means there might be game-breaking bugs present. If you encounter a bug, or something that you don't (or do) like, please post a message on our community hub, or report it on our Discord channel. (Link to the Discord channel is below this post.) 

Once we've fixed some bugs in Beta 19, implemented community feedback and are happy with how everything looks and feels we'll release it for everyone on the public branch! We do not have a solid release date yet, but we aim to release Beta 19 for everyone in December 2018. 

[h1]New Server Racks (Beta 20)[/h1]
Recently we announced the new programmer and executive setup for your employees. This time around we want to share new server racks with you, as displayed in the image below:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/6fa7439df03d1e29c937dd7721f887421ce89484.png[/img]

We're currently working on a Centralized Clockrate Controller (CCC) in Startup Company, which is a highly requested feature by our community. This new unit can control the clockrate for up to 500 servers.

A practical example would be: if you reach 90% overall CU usage, the CCC will change the clockrate from 50% to 100%. It will be cool to see how everyone will make use of this new feature! 

Together with the new and improved X Servers this will allow everyone to make sure that your company is ready for the future - especially when you're being DDoS'd or get a viral boost to handle all the traffic!

With Beta 20 two new server types will be introduced into the game: the Small and the Large X Server. These new servers are a lot bigger compared to the existing servers. The X Servers are a great choice to combine with the CCC to keep expenses low, while still having the power to overcome increased traffic.

[b]Beta 18 is now available! Restart Steam to get it right away![/b]

With Beta 18 being live right now we've added a bunch of new features, fixed a lot of issues and listened closely to what the community wanted. 

We're very excited and nervous at the same time, as releasing new features that change the game in many different ways result in a lot of new feedback and buzz in our community. 

As always, with an update there might be some bugs. But rest assured, we're focused on making sure that everything gets fixed as soon as possible with potential hotfixes. 🔵Fixed bug where Sales Executive couldn't create new contracts if all competitors were merged.
🔵Fixed bug causing game to crash when deleting a savegame while viewing a hosting building.

[h1]Progress on 'Random Events'[/h1]
As we announced last week we're working on a new feature named ''Random Events'', which as the name suggest happen on random occasions during the game to spice things up. 

We're working on adding a bunch of these events, and more will be added over time to continue building upon this feature. (And of course by taking community suggestions into account!) 

Some of the random events that you will encounter once BETA 18 has been released: 

🔵Viral Boost: your product goes viral and generates a lot of new users.
🔵DDoS attacks: an unknown group will attack your servers.  
🔵Poaching: your competitors will try to steal your best employees.
🔵Employee decisions: employees want raises or else they quit.

[i]Random events only happen if you have more than 100K users using your product. In addition to that you can only get the random viral boost effect if your user satisfaction is above 70%.[/i]

In [url=shttps://steamcommunity.com/games/606800/announcements/detail/2620423672034372038]Devlog #27[/url] we posted a screenshot of what it looks like when your company is under a DDoS attack and when an employee wants a raise. This week we'll be showing you what it looks like when your product goes viral and when a competitor wants to steal your employee. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/81b2a0453bbae8d4be39be69f451aca85d6db357.png[/img]

[h1]Highscore[/h1]
Once you've completed everything there is to do in Startup Company you will be rewarded a (high)-score, which lets you measure yourself up against other CEO's playing the game! 

Once this feature is up and running the most seasoned CEO's will be able to earn bragging rights by posting their highest scores!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/082940eb74f5a5bd234ecf3e7dfeb7b8fff10996.gif[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #27
notes.notes:
Hi there! 

We’ve worked very hard on getting a new update ready for everyone.This update will include pretty much everything mentioned in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/606800/announcements/detail/2681220278445707192]Devlog #26[/url] and is now available for everyone. 

We’ve made a couple of adjustments here and there and added a bunch of tool-tips, warnings and fixed a couple of annoying bugs too! 

[h1]Time slots are now implemented.[/h1]
The Ad Space Calendar has been removed from the game and has been replaced by something that we call [i]‘’Time Slots’’[/i]. 

By default you only have one slot (full day) allowing you to have one contract. You can choose to split that into multiple slot slots, allowing you to run multiple contracts on the same feature. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/bec62a2e138c23cf6478578ae80c849f106331ff.png[/img]

[h1]Ad Contracts[/h1]
Ad Deals are now called Ad Contracts. When you go into a contract, you now decide how many impressions per day you want to guarantee. The customer (lead) sets the maximum, but if you can’t meet their expectation you’ll have to lower it. This results in you receiving a smaller payment from the customer.

Contracts can be cancelled but you will incur a penalty amounting to 20% of the payment. This is the reason why increasing your contract length increases your payment.

 [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/9e6fd24fc8ae4cad3cbec427bb4844262943da61.gif[/img]

[h1]Updated Sales Executive dialog[/h1]

Because of the new features as mentioned above we also had to make significant changes to the ‘Sales Executive’ dialog. It now features a graph that shows you how well the ad contract you’re running is performing. In addition to that you will be able to monitor all the leads. 

The employee will be able to manage one contract, but will simultaneously look for better leads. The prices are based on the initial CPM’s that were offered by the customer, which can be improved and raised by negotiating. 

In addition to that, all the contracts can be auto-renewed. This means that you no longer have to accept or deny offers deals. You will only be able to negotiate new contracts with your customers if your daily impressions (better known as online users) have increased significantly. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/9ef9d8e157668aab4095b0bd51f3629d341d6051.png[/img]

[h1]Money animation[/h1]
The money animation as mentioned in the Devlog #26 is now available. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/59c8dc4948a1160212412ee1267ed84f847c0878.gif[/img]

[h1]Gearing up towards Beta 18[/h1]
Now that we've released these new features we're going to continue building on new features, as outlined in our roadmap. 

First up we'll focus on bringing random events to the game. This will spice things up, especially during the mid-game and in the later stages of the game. 

These random effects will cause you some additional headaches, or can be used to your advantage to get some quick market-share! 

In addition to that we're of course always listening to the feedback of the community and make changes if appropriate to the existing features - such as the ones we're releasing today. 

[code][i]Wondering what our roadmap looks like? Make sure to click [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/364d6e6e52b86231a9333526112df710d0d48209.jpg]here![/url][/i][/code]

Here's a little sneak preview of what the random events feature will look like: 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/9940e7375ed92c34e1b8352eb7332505d52d16d6.gif[/img]

[code]Do you have suggestions or ideas for the game? 
Check out [url=https://ideas.startupcompanygame.com]our Conflux board[/url].[/code]

Alright, that’s all for Devlog #27. Thanks for reading, make sure to let us know in the comments what you think about the update!

Best,
Jonas & Robert

notes.title: Devlog #26
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

First of all, sorry for the following wall of text. I have already tried to reduce the length but with no luck :-) 

[h1]The Beta 17 release was awful[/h1]
For various reasons, the Beta 17 release was not as great an experience as I had hoped it would be. I’d like to apologize to all of you who had a bad experience with the new beta. 

While I always try to do my best, I’m still learning and with Beta 17 a lot of mistakes became obvious:

[b]Translations were not ready on time[/b]
When I started translating Startup Company into multiple languages, I didn’t have the money to pay translators to do the work. Instead, I asked the community for help and a lot of people have been helping out over and over again, translating each new beta in their native language.

This has been amazing and I’m very thankful to everyone who helped out over the years.

Unfortunately for this release, I was still missing translations for six languages one day before the release date. My solution was to start contacting professional translators and pay them to translate the missing strings within 24 hours. It was obviously quite expensive but also the reason why I had to postpone the release.

To ensure this won’t happen again, I have chosen to outsource all translation work to a professional translation company.

[b]The transition from Beta 16 to 17 was too steep[/b]
A lot of players experienced their companies shutting down shortly after booting up in Beta 17. The combination of changing the income model (revenue features) and also introducing product satisfaction was simply too much for a lot of players. It resulted in lots of rage quits and a lot of very angry emails coming my way.

The reason is obvious – I was way too ambitious. I wanted Beta 17 to be super exciting, so I introduced a lot of big changes in one big update.

To fix this, I will start releasing more (and smaller) updates, but each one only containing one major change.

[code]The devlog gives a sneak peek into what has been developed on the game over the past week. It is not a new release and is not available yet. New features are always released as official Beta releases.[/code]

[h1]RIP Ad Space Calendar. Welcome to time slots.[/h1]
Overall, I’m quite happy with how the new ad space/deals work, but there are some obvious flaws that have to be fixed.

The first thing is to get rid of the ad spaces calendar as it didn’t really serve any purpose.

Instead, new time slots have been added. An ad contract now runs for a specific number of days. By default, you have one time slot (full day) allowing you to have one contract. You can choose to split that into multiple time slots, allowing you to run multiple contracts on the same feature.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/bec62a2e138c23cf6478578ae80c849f106331ff.png[/img]

[h1]Ad Contracts[/h1]
Ad Deals are now called Ad Contracts. When you go into a contract, you now decide how many impressions per day you want to guarantee. The customer (lead) sets the maximum, but if you can’t meet their expectation you’ll have to lower it. This results in you receiving a smaller payment from the customer.

Contracts can be cancelled but you will incur a penalty amounting to 20% of the payment. This is also the reason why increasing your contract length increases your payment.
 [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/9e6fd24fc8ae4cad3cbec427bb4844262943da61.gif[/img]


[h1]Updated Sales Executive dialog[/h1]
Considering the above changes, I obviously had to also change the Sales Executive dialog. It now features a cool graph that shows you how well the ad contract is performing. You’ll also be able to see all leads. The employee will be able to manage one contract, but also continue searching for better leads. The prices is the initial CPMs offered by the customer, which can be improved by negotiating.

All contracts can be auto renewed, [b]meaning you’ll no longer have to constantly accept or deny deals![/b]. You only negotiate a new contract if your daily impressions (online users) have increased significantly.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/9ef9d8e157668aab4095b0bd51f3629d341d6051.png[/img]

[h1]Money animation[/h1]
It’s not a biggie, but I think it’s really cool. You can now see every time you gain or lose money.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/59c8dc4948a1160212412ee1267ed84f847c0878.gif[/img]

[code]Do you have suggestions or ideas for the game? 
Check out [url=https://ideas.startupcompanygame.com]our Conflux board[/url].[/code]

I plan to release the above changes within the next couple of weeks as a hotfix for Beta 17. There will not be any official release date for this one.

Alright, that’s all for this devlog. Thanks for reading!

Best,
Jonas

notes.title: Beta 17 Released!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/cabe1819ca0a54fe26ab72511bc7a4d2f0b0abbe.jpg[/img]

[b]Hi everyone,[/b]

[b]Beta 17 is now available! Restart Steam to get it right away![/b]

60 days. That’s the number of days since the last major update, which is 14 days less than with the Beta 16 release! 

Beta 17 adds some of the most complicated mechanics ever seen in the game. I’m both excited and nervous to get your feedback on this update as balancing the game has been hard. I wanted the game to increase in difficulty, but at the same time remain friendly to new players. I am really keen to get your feedback on this one so please let me know what you think.

As with any big update, it is guaranteed that there will still be a ton of bugs, we just haven’t found them all yet. If you come across any, please let me know in the Bugs forum (https://steamcommunity.com/app/606800/discussions/1/). I’m going to release hotfixes on a daily basis until everything is stable.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/6138623b1ace6d9fc3fe47346a3c380c9971c985.jpg[/img]
[h1]The Big Marketing Update[/h1]
The marketing functionality has been completely rewritten. You will no longer have to constantly restart campaigns. Instead, I was inspired by the real world, where your campaign’s success will be based on your ability to correctly target the relevant audience.

Campaigns can run for much longer and the amount of hired marketers is much lower than before.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/a9ed9cc1d0c739729c6514117b37586e8ee9bce3.gif[/img]

[h1]Product Satisfaction[/h1]
Beta 17 also introduces a new variable to your products: Satisfaction. You’ll now have to improve features based on user feedback. The total satisfaction is based on the average of all features. Satisfaction will directly impact your conversion rate when running marketing campaigns. Running a product with just a landing page won’t be very interesting anymore.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/3c38293d4f0ba9f1833e061a45b606486200ed62.png[/img]

[h1]New revenue-based features[/h1]
This change is [b]huge[/b]! Features are no longer just for increasing your “potential users”. They are now also for creating new revenue channels. You’ll be able to choose between Text Ads, Banner Ads, Video Ads and Subscriptions. Each one will take up one feature slot of your product. Until you create a revenue source, your product’s will generate $0 by default.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/08e379bc87e390dfd896a5ade5028cbf2f5c0ebf.png[/img]

[h1]Revenue from subscriptions[/h1]
If you choose to add a “Subscriptions” feature to your product, you can offer specific features as a “premium” offering to your users. This means that your users will have to pay a monthly subscription in order to access the feature. The higher the monthly fee and the more features affected, the less happy your users will be. However, it will also increase your revenue. Balancing this out is hard. You generally need a very good product to get away with subscriptions.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/10ca0277f3fba002adc87f9c013908f1a7f29cdc.png[/img]

[h1]Revenue from selling ads[/h1]
Another way of generating revenue is adding banner/ad spaces to your product. Adding a feature will take up one “feature slot”. Once added, your Sales Executives will be able to search for clients interested in running ads on your product. 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/GAXMRUc.gif[/img]

Once a deal is accepted, you’ll have to schedule when the ad should be run. All “ad space deals” have a specific pay per 1000 impressions.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/4975a42156301fb809ebe8b691cb0cceb5fb4eb7.png[/img]

[h1]Other changes[/h1]
[list]
  [*] Contract Work has been removed from the game.
  [*] New marketing components added: AB Testing, Analytics Research, Behavior Observation, Phone Interview, Survey and User Feedback.
  [*] New base features: Item Listing, Live Streaming and Offline Content.
  [*] Mods and “contract work” related Steam achievements have been removed.
  [*] New achievements added: “Sell Out”, “Addicted”, “Fireworks”, “The Zuck” and “The Overclocker”.
  [*] Organic growth activated again.
  [*] Balanced loss rate of product progression (caused by new satisfaction variable).
  [*] Various changes to feature’s level upgrade requirements.
  [*] New research point requirements for both features and frameworks.
  [*] DevOps renamed to SysAdmin.
  [*] “Delete All” and “Mark All As Read” buttons added to the inbox.
  [*] Fixed bug that allowed players to exceed the maximum number of virtual servers.
  [*] 28 other minor changes that didn’t make this list :-)
[/list]

[h1]Quality of Chinese localization[/h1]
Due to issues with my Chinese translator I have been forced to use Google Translate for this update. This is obviously unacceptable, so I'll work through the weekend to ensure a high quality translation will be provided as fast as possible.


So that’s Beta 17. To be honest, it has been one of the tougher releases and has required lots of complicated code to be written.

I expect the next two weeks to be all about hotfixing Beta 17, which is why there won’t be any devlogs until September 14. Once Beta 17 is stable, I’m moving straight on to Beta 18, which will introduce the new “event system” that I know a lot of you have been looking forward to. This will introduce random events to the game, that you’ll have to deal with in order to protect your beloved company :-)

Thanks for reading! I hope you enjoy Beta 17.

All the best,
Jonas

[*] Changed the way product satisfaction is calculated by using positive percentage instead of negative (Text Ads is now 30% instead of -30% for example). This greatly increases product satisfaction.
[*] Temporary disabled userloss for existing savegames to make transition for Beta 16 players easier.

notes.title: Devlog #24
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/GAXMRUc.gif[/img]

Hi everyone,

Just finishing off another busy week (as always!). I was considering postponing this devlog, but I’m really eager to show you the new negotiation feature!

Beta 17 has really come together these last couple of weeks. The new features are in place and I’m now entering the test and balancing phase.

[code]The devlog gives a sneak peek into what has been developed on the game over the past week. It is not a new release and is not available yet. New features are always released as official Beta releases.[/code]

[h1]Sales Executive: The Negotiation[/h1] 
Beta 17 introduces new revenue-based features, including Text Ads, Banner Ads and Video Ads. Adding any of these features to your product allows you to sell ad space on your product to generate revenue.

To sell this ad space, you need a Sales Executive to search for deals (just like the old contracts feature). Once a deal is found, you’ll have to do the negotiation. When dealing with a customer, it’s important to consider both their mood and the offers they submit. If a customer becomes too angry during the negotiation, they will simply leave in a huff. On the other hand, if you negotiate correctly, you can get much better deals, leading to higher revenue for your product.

The feature is very complicated so I won’t go into too much detail right now. If you’re worried about having to do the negotiation manually every time, I can assure you that this won’t be the case. Once a deal with a customer is in place, you can stick with the agreed price in the future.

[h1] “Contract Work” removed from Startup Company[/h1]
Yes, you read that right. Contract work will not feature in Beta 17. Shortly after I released the feature, I had the feeling that it didn’t quite match my vision for Startup Company. After investors were introduced to the game, it became very clear that it was completely unrealistic that a company funded by investors would start doing contract work for other companies. 

To be honest, I’m a bit fearful of the reactions to this. There is a large portion of my playerbase who are only generating revenue through contract work. Beta 17 will definitely be a huge change for them.

[h1]Updated Roadmap[/h1]
I have updated the roadmap to match the latest progress. As it shows, Beta 17 is planned for release in two weeks. While this isn’t a guarantee, as we’ve still got a ton of work to do, I think it’s a realistic timeframe.

Jonas

notes.title: Devlog #23
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/6389cdbc441f1a76fba8fcc3dff4d551444bd015.png[/img]

Hi everyone,

The last couple of weeks of coding have been quite intense. The new marketing and “revenue features” are really complex and take up many more lines of code than what I’ve been working on over the last year. Hopefully it will all be worth it! :-)

[code]The devlog gives a sneak peek into what has been developed on the game over the past week. It is not a new release and is not available yet. New features are always released as official Beta releases.[/code]

[h1]Completion of the new marketing feature[/h1]
I showed the “configuration” of new campaigns in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/606800/announcements/detail/1696051418584890899]last devlog[/url]. I put the final pieces together last week. The screenshot below shows the stats view for the campaign. You’re able to pause campaigns and change the daily budget on the fly. The “Create Report” button gives you insight into variables of the campaign so you can assess whether it is efficient, but not until you have reached 10% of the targeted audience.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/7c7b9d121f7061258e2b14f6ff637d66e4907bc4.png[/img]

[h1]New revenue-based features[/h1]
This change is [b]huge[/b]! Features are no longer just for increasing your “potential users”. They are now also for creating new revenue channels. You’ll be able to choose between Text Ads, Banner Ads, Video Ads and Subscriptions. Each one will take up one feature slot of your product. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/25e7d29f1868b808ec9445c588b5e0eebc914208.png[/img]

[h1]Revenue from subscriptions[/h1]
If you choose to add a “Subscriptions” feature to your product, you can offer specific features as a “premium” offering to your users. This means that your users will have to pay a monthly subscription in order to access the feature. The higher the monthly fee and the more features affected, the less happy your users will be. However, it will also increase your revenue. Balancing this out is hard. You generally need a very good product to get away with subscriptions.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/10ca0277f3fba002adc87f9c013908f1a7f29cdc.png[/img]

[h1]Revenue from selling ads[/h1]
Another way of generating revenue is adding banner/ad spaces to your product. Again, this is a feature you have to add that will take up one “feature slot”. Once added, your Sales Executives will be able to search for clients interested in running ads on your product. 

Once a deal is accepted, you’ll have to schedule when the ad should be run. All “ad contracts” have a specific pay per 1000 impressions. This allows you to run the highest paid contracts when you get the most traffic (primarily weekends but depends on product type). I have only just started working on this feature this week, so [b]what you see is very much a work in progress and will probably change![/b]
 [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/6389cdbc441f1a76fba8fcc3dff4d551444bd015.png[/img]

[h1]Next week[/h1]
I hope you all can see how massive these updates are. Beta 17 won’t be the biggest update, but I think it will feel like it.

Next week I’m going to continue working on the “Selling Ads” functionality. One thing that I’m very excited about is creating the new “negotiation mode” where you have to negotiate with clients about Ad Space pricing. It will be a bit like the current contract bidding, but much more advanced.

[code]Do you have suggestions or ideas for the game? 
Check out [url=https://ideas.startupcompanygame.com]our Conflux board[/url].[/code]

I’m not 100% sure about next week’s devlog as these features take up a huge amount of time. I’ll let you know via [url=https://twitter.com/hovgaardgames]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/hovgaardgames]Discord[/url] if the devlog will be postponed.

Thanks for reading!

Best,
Jonas

notes.title: Devlog #22
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/a9ed9cc1d0c739729c6514117b37586e8ee9bce3.gif[/img]

[b]Hi everyone,[/b]

This has been an amazing week! I was finally able to finish hotfixing Beta 16 and go all-in on Beta 17 development. 

[h1]The Big Marketing Update[/h1]
I’ve been putting a lot of hours into designing this new update. I’ve read all of your [b]126 marketing suggestions on Conflux[/b] and hope I’ve been able to combine all of the best ideas.

You’ll be able to run Text Ads, Banner Ads, Video Ads, Radio/Podcast commercials and TV commercials.

The mechanics of marketing have been changed quite a lot. You now start by creating the campaign. Next you can start/stop the campaign and set a maximum daily budget. [b]You are no longer required to constantly restart campaigns.[/b]

Each campaign will have a potential reach and a conversion rate. The conversion rate is based on a lot of different variables. Not only is the satisfaction of the feature you’re promoting taken into consideration, you’ll also be able to target the correct audience to get a good conversion rate.

Once a campaign has reached 10% of its potential reach, you’ll be able to analyze the campaign and get insight into what variables increased or decreased the conversion rate. This insight allows you to create more efficient campaigns in the future.

The conversion rate will vary a lot. Creating effective marketing campaigns will dramatically boost your product. 

Everything is directly inspired by my own experience with marketing and I believe I got quite close to the real world with this one. I wish I could let you try it out right away :-)

[h1]New Framework Limitations[/h1]
A big issue and “immersion-breaker” is the possibility to earn millions of dollars with a product that only contains a Landing Page. This will be fixed in Beta 17. You’ll now have to max out your current framework in order to upgrade to the next one. This means you’re forced to max out all 3 features until you can increase the “max feature level”.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/abb21e9e730858664ffce40065a964f2fd4435f6.png[/img]

[h1]Satisfaction[/h1]
Beta 17 will also introduce a new variable to your products: Satisfaction. You’ll now have to improve features based on user feedback. The total satisfaction is based on the average of all features. Satisfaction will directly impact your conversion rate when running marketing campaigns.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/3c38293d4f0ba9f1833e061a45b606486200ed62.png[/img]

[h1]The return of organic growth[/h1]
Organic growth will return to the game. The amount of traffic is based on overall product satisfaction.

[h1]Reset Peak CU[/h1]
By popular demand, you will be able to reset the Peak CU counter whenever you like.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/dec7d90d32a48cb9ac5842c2f9f0b8d732faacc4.png[/img]

[h1]Inbox Improvements[/h1]
Another one by popular demand. You are no longer required to delete emails one by one.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/73b71851f871f5b344e5b99fb12a17c39adecd86.png[/img]

Thanks for reading!

All the best,
Jonas

notes.title: Devlog #21
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I’ve had some very busy days since the release of Beta 16. Not only has the Summer Sale attracted a lot of new users, but I have also spent a lot of hours fixing bugs in Beta 16. A total of six hotfixes have been shipped pushing the latest version to “Beta 16.6”. 

[b]Here’s a list of all the bugs that were fixed:[/b]

🔵 Hide stock options while merging is active.
🔵 Disable “move workstation” button while office building is not selected.
🔵 Fixed various typos/localization issues.
🔵 Fixed bug causing owned stocks percentage to not show 0–1% ownership.
🔵 French version: fixed unavailable framework buttons.
🔵 German version: fixed typo in product merge text.
🔵 Fixed bug allowing players to place hosting equipment in their office.
🔵 Removed incorrect hosting building expenses from product hosting tab.
🔵 Reduced “new product requirements” to be 15 completed milestones instead of a complete buyout.
🔵 Returned missing office items (walls, glass door, etc.)
🔵 Fixed bug causing rack devices to be lost when buying without any space available.
🔵 Updated “Upgrade Employee Level” feature to add one new demand per upgrade.
🔵 Fixed bug causing product stats to show broken graphs if game was paused.
🔵 Fixed bug causing “New Tier” dialog to show on every load.
🔵 Fixed bug where the running cost of air conditioners was not included.
🔵 Fixed bug crashing the game after upgrading specific employees.
🔵 Fixed bug allowing players to create a new product too soon.
🔵 Added “Yesterday” product traffic graph for other languages than English.
🔵 Fixed wrong max. buy amount for buying stocks.
🔵 Disabled “upgrade workstation” button when not in office building.
🔵 Fixed wrong translations in PT-BR version.
🔵 Show error when player is trying to merge two products of different types.
🔵 Buffed email marketing campaign.
🔵 Fixed bug causing wrong ESC behavior after moving an item between floors.
🔵 Changed “office/hosting building quick switcher” to a single toggle button
🔵 Fixed bug causing competitors to stay in “Merge in progress” state.
🔵 Fixed bug happening when merging multiple competitors into same product.
🔵 Increased basement hosting building cost from 10k to 20k to avoid new players renting the wrong building.
🔵 Disabled ESC key when time machine is running.
🔵 Changed milestone behavior to only allow unlocking of the next milestone “in line”.
🔵 Fixed issue where hosting allocation was 0% for first product.
🔵 Introduced new one-button building switcher.

[h1]The road to full release[/h1]
With Beta 16 safely shipped, I’m now starting to really work towards the final version of Startup Company. There’s still a lot of work to be done, but it’s now much clearer to me what needs to be done.

To share my vision with you, I’ve created this roadmap showing you the future of SC. It will probably change a lot and nothing should be considered as “official”, but for the first time you can now see where I’m headed.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/31a507d5900bc0ccb909ec15a14188357a8e593c.png[/img]

[h1]Feature suggestions overflow[/h1]
Firstly, I would like to thank all of you who send me suggestions and ideas for the game. I really appreciate it and use your suggestions a lot when designing the game.

I’m currently receiving between 10 and 15 suggestions per day. That’s at least 300 per month! I used to respond to all of your suggestions, but recently I have decided to prioritize developing the game. I still read [b]everything[/b]. I hope you understand. :-)

[code]Do you have suggestions or ideas for the game? 
Check out [url=https://ideas.startupcompanygame.com]our Conflux board[/url].[/code]

Thanks for reading and see you next week!

Best,
Jonas

notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/4fa027189a292b74da670114f79613ea11319eba.png[/img]

[b]Hi everyone,[/b]

[b]Beta 16 is now available! Restart Steam to get it right away![/b]

74 days. That’s the number of days since the last major update. I’m very proud of this release. Not only is it the [b]biggest update yet[/b], it’s also very special to me because Startup Company is now starting to become the game I always envisioned it to be.

As with any big update, it is guaranteed that there will still be a ton of bugs, we just haven’t found them yet. If you come across any, please let me know in the Bugs forum (https://steamcommunity.com/app/606800/discussions/1/). I’m going to release hotfixes daily until everything is stable.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/4a57c036ee8f64b6fa543caa6ad7084bb8dc6292.png[/img]


[h1]Hosting Buildings[/h1]
Beta 16 is introducing a complete rewrite of the hosting functionality. The first step was adding new buildings dedicated to hosting. There are now three brand new buildings available.

Virtual Servers will continue to be part of the game, but a maximum CU cap will be implemented to force players into building their own hosting facilities.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/3dac57da7e3e65d8b549b99e4e7fd1ecdd09d3f0.jpg[/img]

[h1]Racks and Servers[/h1]
In these hosting buildings, you will only be able to place hosting related equipment such as server racks. By clicking on server racks, you will be able to easily configure each rack and design for maximum performance.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/8ada824476bc4dac300ec994e6748282425af962.png[/img]

[h1]City Map[/h1]
With the introduction of hosting buildings, it was clear that the game needed a better and more immersive way of showing buildings. This will be done with the brand new City Map.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/03d0b9978c30232d797c1fcd492d350abc20e37e.png[/img]

[h1]New investor milestones[/h1]
Beta 15 introduced the new investor milestones which were mainly focused on the early game. Beta 16 adds a bunch of new milestones that get you around both the new hosting center and the new acquisition/buyout feature.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/df45130c100048e0392320aa9885b7f381d79dfe.png[/img]

[h1]Investment Offers[/h1]
You will now receive offers from other investors as your product grows. While the investors will own a share of your product, they will also instantly transfer you a ton of cash. This cash can be used to acquire competitors!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/c65fc93ba6ca0ec24ab364ee86f24b85d2b5d613.jpg[/img]

[h1]Acquire competitors[/h1]
Once you own 100% of a company through buying all of its stock, you’ll now be able to merge the competitor product into your own product, in the process acquiring the competitor’s users. A merger takes seven days to complete. You’ll have to prepare your own product for new potential users and server demands before starting the merger. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/ed488b01794838623db920e343e73c311002c42a.jpg[/img]

[h1]New competitor logos[/h1]
A new logo pack has also been added to Beta 16. The game now features 100 unique company logos.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/bc26bb1236ab6313153439a014bdc27c214b2b8c.jpg[/img]

So there you have it. I really hope you enjoy this update!

Lastly, I would like to say thank you to everyone who continues to support my development of Startup Company. I really appreciate all of your comments and kind words. They keep me going at full speed, even when haters go nuts in the review section! <3

Hi everyone,

Huge progress on the new hosting features this week!

[code]The devlog gives a sneak peek into what has been developed on the game over the past week. It is not a new release and is not available yet. New features are always released as official Beta releases.[/code]

[h1]Racks[/h1]
As mentioned last week, the new hosting facilities allow you to place racks. Once a rack has been placed, you can install equipment such as servers, coolers, etc. All equipment can be rearranged using drag and drop.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/1FBoqIn.gif[/img]

[h1]Throughput, overclocking and temperatures[/h1]
There are now 3 types of servers: web servers, database servers and cache servers. Each instance of a server produces a specific throughput. You’ll have to balance these server times to get the most out of your hosting facility. You can now see real-time stats above the bottom menu:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/15820c649e69099068d12ca6c0f5d2e88d0e0f09.jpg[/img]

The new hosting facilities can work side by side with existing virtual servers:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/2588942ab3a36432d17e2b2e93fcb62d35b1b6ad.jpg[/img]

Check out [url=https://ideas.startupcompanygame.com]our Conflux board[/url].[/code]

Jonas

notes.title: Devlog #16
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/1bd6d95acd93621758047077316452fdbb1f9a83.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone,

A ton of work has been put into Beta 16 this week. I’ve also been working on rectifying a problem causing the first savegame to be lost for a small portion of first-time players. 

[code]The devlog gives a sneak peek into what has been developed on the game over the past week. It is not a new release and is not available yet. New features are always released as official Beta releases.[/code]

[h1]Hosting Buildings[/h1]
Beta 16 is introducing a complete rewrite of the hosting functionality. The first step is adding new buildings dedicated to hosting. The first hosting building to be introduced will be the cheapest option and it will be located in a basement close to the small office.

In these new locations, you will only be able to place hosting related equipment such as server racks. By clicking on server racks, you will be able to easily configure each rack and design for maximum performance. I’ll describe and show screenshots of the “rack configurator” in next week’s devlog.

Virtual Servers will continue to be part of the game, but a maximum CU cap will be implemented to force players into building their own hosting facilities.

[h1]City Map[/h1]
With the introduction of hosting buildings, it was clear that the game needed a better and more immersive way of showing buildings. This will be done with the brand new City Map. I don’t have any screenshots available yet, but I hope to be able to show it in a couple of weeks.

🔵 Automatically disable and hide “Big UI” functionality if screen height is below 1440.
🔵 If saving to disk fails, the game will now throw an error and stop the game, forcing the player to restart the game. Errors will also be shown to the player for further research.

🔵 Added “Big UI” support to new “upgrade feature” dialog.
🔵 Fixed bug causing deleted savegames to reappear.

notes.title: Devlog #15
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/0cef16a7627385e4c3584a6ea442ead586dc7846.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone,

What an insane week this has been. 14,207 unique players have played a total of 29,678 games since Beta 15’s release last Thursday. Safe to say I didn't expect such high numbers one year ago :-)

As with all sales, Steam review score is being hammered right now. Went from 76% to 67%. No big deal, we tried this before.

This week I have obviously been bug hunting. There have been a couple of UI problems as well as regular bugs. Beta 15.1 was published yesterday, which removed some of the bugs, but I expect to spend at least one more week fixing bugs.

[code]The devlog gives a sneak peek into what has been developed on the game over the past week. It is not a new release and is not available yet. New features are always released as official Beta releases.[/code]

[h1]Improved upgrade feature dialog[/h1]
By popular demand, the upgrade feature dialog has been greatly improved, and now shows more details about each level. A multiplier has also been added for level upgrades, allowing you to upgrade multiple levels with one click.

[h1]Beta 15 minor changes[/h1]
🔵 Fixed bug causing exception when trying to switch floor before the game was fully loaded.
🔵 Fixed bug causing newly purchased marketing campaign to be instantly canceled.
🔵 Changed Lead Developer behavior to allow them to select a module even if the requirements are not yet met  (“missing requirements” label shown instead).
🔵 Fixed bug causing “required modules of modules ” to duplicate if the task was canceled.
🔵 Rebalanced product type income, making social media less lucrative.
🔵 Redesigned feature upgrade view.
🔵 Added confirm button for deleting features.
🔵 Fixed bug making it impossible to buy NetFix stocks.
🔵 Fixed bug causing achievements not to be unlocked on Steam.
🔵 Fixed bug where a milestone payout wouldn’t show correctly in the transaction log.
🔵 Fixed bug making it impossible to click the “Move workstation” button if the correct floor wasn’t selected.
🔵 Reduced investor buyout price.
🔵 Increased milestone payouts to allow going through game without completing contracts.
🔵 Temporary disabled investor's daily cut.
🔵 Fixed bug causing marketing campaigns to always start at $100.

[h1]What’s coming in Beta 16[/h1]
With Beta 15 successfully released, it’s time to get started on the next one. While Beta 15 focused on improving the early stage of the game, Beta 16 will focus on improving late-game performance. 

Firstly, I want to reduce clicks and implement more automation. My first objective is to rewrite the marketing functionality and allow for more complicated setups with much more control.

Secondly, I’m looking into adding more goals and objectives, especially when it comes to competitors and stocks. I’ve received more than 500 unique suggestions from you guys, which I’m now working my way through. I hope to introduce something specific in the next week. 

That’s all for this week. Thanks for reading. 

All the best,
Jonas

[b]UPDATE: Devlog #16 is postponed till next week (May 4).[/b]

notes.title: Beta 15 Released!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/3904bf55df6b6686e15288efb0960b3d2f2823a1.png[/img]

[b]I’m delighted to finally announce that Beta 15 is now available on Steam![/b]

With this release, I’ve been focusing on adding more personality and a stronger startup-feel to the game. I am confident that new players will find the game much more appealing and user-friendly.

[b]To all existing players:[/b] your savegames are compatible with Beta 15, but please note that the new investor feature is only available on new products. Due to the new interface, feature instances have also been revised so only your activated instances will be included in Beta 15.

[b]If you don’t like the changes in Beta 15, you can now switch back to Beta 14 using Steam’s “Betas” feature. The different versions now use separate savegames.[/b]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/4a57c036ee8f64b6fa543caa6ad7084bb8dc6292.png[/img]

[h1]Feelings & Emotions[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/90d5d1e6bc0c64e3e345810df28386a6507baa7a.jpg[/img]
In short, the update adds personality, demands and feelings to all of your employees. This week I have been working on emotions. Employees will now express feelings through speech and thoughts.

[h1]New “Demands” System[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/ebb5f899f16fd5edeb34279b0844670db5a770bd.png[/img]
Work Environment Rating (or WER) has confused players for a long time. Beta 15 will include neither WER nor the “office bonus”, but instead introduce employee demands. A demand can be specific furniture, benefits, a desk type or short work days. For each demand you fulfill, the employee will receive a speed bonus and will also stay happy for a longer period of time. Employees can generate new demands over time.

[h1]Investors[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/dc717a345c43adadf5c79b2e6913425d864755db.jpg[/img]
Beta 15 will feature investors for the first time. When starting a new game or creating your first product, you’ll be asked to select between an investor or bootstrapping. Bootstrapping means taking care of funding yourself. New players should choose an investor. Investors take a cut in revenue but provide both money and advice (tutorial mode). Beta 15 currently only offers one investor, but more will be added later.

[h1]Venture Capital and Milestones[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/0bc0cc117b8652460d85de7b033c272b8972ca10.jpg[/img]
The product dialog will contain a new tab called Venture Capital, which replaces the existing “Goals” feature. In this tab, you’ll be able to buyout your investor and see a list of all milestones.

Milestones are how the investors set their expectations for you. Once you reach a milestone, a fixed dollar amount will be paid out. 

The dialog also allows you to buy out your investor, meaning you will receive 100% of revenue from then on.

[h1]Simplified Infrastructure Tab[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/f08d3fdac4873118b8bcc033f55b805c178d3820.jpg[/img]
A lot of players have been struggling to understand the Infrastructure tab. To make it easier to understand, the tab has been renamed “Features”. The name change is accompanied by some neat updates:
[list]
[*]To improve instances (now features), you simply have to click “Upgrade” by hovering over the feature (you no longer need to go to the Lead Dev to improve features). 
[*]Screenshots have been added to visualize the feature. 
[*]The old “Quality” term has been changed to “Level”.
[*] Features can now be upgraded while in use.
[*] Frameworks now have a limited number of “feature slots”, starting with three features for the Basic Framework.
[/list]

[h1]Other Beta 15 changes[/h1]
🔵 Discord’s Rich Presence functionality is now supported.
🔵 Fixed recruitment bug causing fewer candidates to be put forward if fast-forwarding or using time-machine.
🔵 Deleted entered email from options.json after subscribing to the newsletter.
🔵 Improved “Big UI”/4K support for the product tabs.
🔵 Fixed bug causing an error to happen when firing employees.
🔵 Allow mods/workshop items to be installed even if Steam Cloud Sync is disabled.
🔵 Buffed rate of losing users when potential users are lower than registered users.
🔵 Adjusted required tiers for unlocking employees to fit new investor feature. 
🔵 Reduced server requirements and increased prices for Virtual Clusters.
🔵 Increased income per user for all product types.
🔵 Fixed bug causing changes to mods to be reset when reloading the game.
🔵 Force player to create a product when starting a new game.
🔵 Disabled Angular debug info for performance gains.
🔵 Fixed issue causing an error when switching to the menu while employee dialog is open.
🔵 Fixed issue causing contracts requiring modules to be too cheap.
🔵 Fixed issue causing the fast forward function to skip every third in-game minute.
🔵 Changed click behavior to react to button down instead of button up.
🔵 Added keyboard shortcut CTRL+1-5 to quickly switch between floors.
🔵 Added number formatting to product graphs.
🔵 Increased marketing effect.
🔵 Nerfed organic growth.
🔵 Updated product stats page to show “new visitors” instead of “origin”.

[h1]I hope you enjoy it![/h1]
So, there you have it. Beta 15 in all its glory! I really hope you like all the changes. I’m now going to take a few days off before getting started on Beta 16, which will introduce at least two big new features! More information coming in future devlogs.

Thanks for reading!

All the best,
Jonas

notes.title: Devlog #12
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I feel that the game is really coming together quickly at the moment. The new investor feature is bringing a whole new feeling to the game. As I have said before, Beta 15 is undoubtedly going to be the biggest update to the game so far. While there’s no release date available yet, I expect it to be shipped around the beginning of April.

[code]The devlog gives a sneak peek into what has been developed on the game over the past week. It is not a new release and is not available yet. New features are always released as official Beta releases.[/code]

[h1]Updated Product Creation Page[/h1]
The product creation page is now being shown as the first page when you start a new game. It has been updated to show competitors for each product type. A new competitor has been added called NetTix.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/2d02446aa6c291dfbfe70f9b275761313faf8139.jpg[/img]

[h1]Simplified Infrastructure Tab[/h1]
A lot of players have been struggling to understand the Infrastructure tab. To make it easier to understand, the tab has been renamed “Features”. The name change is accompanied by some neat updates:
[list]
[*]To improve instances (now features), you simply have to click “Upgrade” by hovering over the feature (you no longer need to go to the Lead Dev to improve features). 
[*]Screenshots have been added to visualize the feature. 
[*]The old “Quality” term has been changed to “Level”.
[*] Features can now be upgraded while in use.
[*] Frameworks now have a limited number of “feature slots”, starting with three features for the Basic Framework.
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/f08d3fdac4873118b8bcc033f55b805c178d3820.jpg[/img]

[h1]Updated Researcher[/h1]
The Researcher will now generate Research Points that you can spend on unlocking features and frameworks. Using a points system makes it much easier to administer compared to the previous solution where you had to choose which framework/feature to research. I plan on using Research Points to unlock other aspects of the game in the future.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/4bd6975ef4a17ee2135ba273a7a73cc1ee3e3cf0.jpg[/img]


[h1]The Advisor[/h1]
Introducing the advisor as part of the new investor update. When you choose to partner with an investor, you’ll now get helpful messages/instructions from your advisor, telling you how to complete the next milestone. Obviously, this works as a tutorial mode in disguise. The advisor can be closed and re-opened by clicking on it. New profile photos for advisors/investors are in the making :-)
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/c2c74fc5ef44ad8cd30e97d15ae1557e06151c55.jpg[/img]

[h1]Minor Beta 15 Changes[/h1]
🔵 Changed DevOps to unlock at Tier 4 instead of Tier 6.
🔵 Changed HR Manager to unlock at Tier 8 instead of Tier 7.
🔵 Changed click behavior to react to button down instead of button up.

[b]Next week’s devlog is postponed by at least one week. I’ll spend next week working on balancing and performance (which would result in a very boring devlog).[/b]

That’s all for now. Thanks for reading. I’ll be back in a couple of weeks :-)

All the best,
Jonas
