Hi everyone,

I’ve had a great week and made a lot of progress on Beta 15! 

The game’s Steam Review Score has once again fallen below 70%. I believe this is related to the new Steam sales that were made last week. 

I only shipped one hotfix this week. Beta 14 seems pretty stable now.

[h1]Beta 14.2[/h1]
🔵 Fixed bug that was causing time machine to get stuck in a loop if HR manager was set to all days off.
🔵 Increased ground floor of the skyscraper to ensure players don’t lose desks/furniture when upgrading.
🔵 Increased max. employees of the skyscraper to 180.

[code]The devlog gives a sneak peek into what has been developed on the game over the past week. It is not a new release and is not available yet. New features are always released as official Beta releases.[/code]

[h1]Beta 15[/h1]
🔵 Added keyboard shortcut CTRL+1-5 to quickly switch between floors.
🔵 Added number formatting to product graphs.
🔵 Increased marketing effect.
🔵 Nerfed organic growth.
🔵 Updated product stats page to show ”new visitors” instead of ”origin”.

[h1]Investors[/h1]
Beta 15 will feature investors for the first time. When starting a new game or creating your first product, you’ll be asked to select between three investors. Each investor will ask you for a different share. Investors asking for a high share will provide you with more funds early on, but will consequently be more expensive to buyout later as your product evolves. Investors asking for a smaller share will provide less initial funding, making the early stages harder but also making it cheaper to buyout the investor later in the game.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/dc717a345c43adadf5c79b2e6913425d864755db.jpg[/img]

[h1]Venture Capital and Milestones[/h1]
The product dialog will contain a new tab called Venture Capital, which replaces the existing ”Goals” feature. In this tab, you’ll be able to buyout your investor and see a list of all milestones.

Milestones are how the investors set their expectations for you. Once you reach a milestone, a fixed dollar amount will be paid out. 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/0bc0cc117b8652460d85de7b033c272b8972ca10.jpg[/img]

[h1]Increased Skyscraper Floor Space[/h1]
A lot of players have been left confused when upgrading from the large building to the skyscraper as all desks and furniture located outside of the skyscraper’s 15x15 floor space are automatically sold and employees have to be re-seated. To fix this, the skyscraper’s floor space has been increased from 15x15 to 20x20. A fancy lift has also been attached to the building.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/30908cd1521a7f19828e834131c5dbc03a94834a.jpg[/img]

[h1]Updated Product Stats[/h1]
The products overlay is now showing registered users instead of online users. New visitors and server usage (%) has also been added.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/671cffa7bc1a74446c0b7ce8b6c62285b0d0080e.jpg[/img]

[code]Do you have suggestions or ideas for the game? 
Check out [url=http://status.startupcompanygame.com]our Conflux board[/url].[/code]

Quite a lot for one week, isn’t it?

That’s all for now. Thanks for reading. I’ll be back next Friday :-)

[b]Next week's devlog is postponed 1 week. Got a ton of new stuff to show you March 9th.[/b]

All the best,
Jonas

notes.title: Devlog #10
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Firstly, I’d like to apologize for the extensive balancing changes for Beta 14 (and the 14.1 hotfix). I know how annoying rebalancing is for you as a player, but it is unfortunately unavoidable while we’re still in Early Access.

One week after the release of Beta 14, I can confirm that it’s probably the most bug-free release so far. I only spent the weekend + Monday fixing bugs. This took almost two weeks for Beta 13!

This means I’ve already been able to start work on Beta 15. 

[code]The devlog gives a sneak peek into what has been developed on the game over the past week. It is not a new release and is not available yet. New features are always released as official Beta releases.[/code]

[h1]Beta 14 Changes[/h1]

🔵 Fixed product’s “Today’s Revenue” which was showing the incorrect amount.
🔵 Fixed “completed contracts” in company window which was stuck at 20.
🔵 Rebalanced potential users gain to fix the issue with negative gain between 7000 and 9000 quality points.
🔵 Changed “Today’s Revenue” to “Today’s Income” to show actual income after expenses (amount in parentheses is revenue only).
🔵 Rebalanced feature bonuses to avoid negative response times.
🔵 Added new time machine functionality to avoid timing issues (slower computers would previously execute this incorrectly).
🔵 Changed employee upgrade salary raise from $1500 to $3000.
🔵 Decreased employee training speed by 33%.
🔵 Fixed bug causing 12-hour clock being shown as a 24-hour clock, but with am/pm appended.
🔵 Added 12hr support for employee working hours.

[h1]The Feels Update[/h1]
This update is a big one for me personally. I’ve really been looking forward to coding this part of the game. In short, the update adds personality, demands and feelings to all of your employees. This week I have been working on emotions. Employees will now express feelings through speech and thoughts.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/f92b0850e1ac88445ee299388b80bd0c63baa119.jpg[/img]

[h1]R.I.P. Work Environment Rating[/h1]
Work Environment Rating or WER has confused players for a long time. I’m now dealing with this. Beta 15 will include neither WER nor the “office bonus”, but instead introduce employee demands. A demand can be specific furniture, benefits, a desk type or short work days. For each demand you fulfill, the employee will receive a speed bonus and will also stay happy for a longer period of time. Employees can generate new demands over time.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/ebb5f899f16fd5edeb34279b0844670db5a770bd.png[/img]

[code]Do you have suggestions or ideas for the game? 
Check out [url=http://status.startupcompanygame.com]our Conflux board[/url].[/code]

That’s all for now. Thanks for reading. I’ll be back next Friday :-)

All the best,
Jonas

notes.title: Beta 14 Released!
notes.notes:
Beta 14 is finally here!

My priority with Beta 14 has been to iron out features that felt inefficient or clumsy. A general complaint has been that there is too much clicking in the game. I hope Beta 14 removes a lot of these clicks and makes the gameplay less cumbersome.

Products have once again been rebalanced. Beta 13 allowed you to gain more users than the population of the world. I’ve fixed this in Beta 14. [b]Take note that your product will now instantly start to lose users if you have more than two billion users. Server demands has also been buffed a lot. This is intended![/b]

[h1]Weekends and days off[/h1]
The HR Manager can now control all employee schedules at once. You can also define which days of the week the employees should take off.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/71a3e90a9b3e6fa484a194c5ed0bda669df67c3c.jpg[/img]

[h1]Tracking stock prices[/h1]
Competitor stock prices are now tracked, making it much easier to figure out when to buy and sell stocks.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/2de27ad422b60e9029092529f20f1f8cd8a02c54.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Activity Log[/h1]
The new activity log replaces the current notification system. Instead of hiding your notifications, you now get a static overview of all activity in the game.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/4759a613801ae8a0bda36f79d8eafaba9c6aa536.jpg[/img]

[h1]Production Functionality[/h1]
The new automated production feature is currently being tested. Currently, you have to manually set the minimum stock amount for each available component/module. Once the limit is reached, employees stop working.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/2825e71ed6e10523fd625324aa1e07fe6e4bac48.jpg[/img]

[h1]Auto-repeat for everyone![/h1]
Players have always disliked the first 10 minutes of the game because of the high volume of clicking that is required. Together with the “Production feature”, I’ve unlocked the Auto-Repeat function for all employees, whether they are assigned to a manager or not. Instead, the manager’s main purpose is to help assign tasks and boost productivity by adding the speed bonus. This should help get rid of a substantial portion of early-game clicks :-)

[h1]Employee Training[/h1]
You can now use training to increase the speed of your employees. Each employee has a “Max Speed” or “Potential Speed”. Once you’ve trained your employee to his/her maximum speed, you’ll be able to upgrade the employee. After upgrading, a higher “Max Speed” will now be available, until the employee reaches “Expert” level. The employee’s final “Max Speed” will vary from employee to employee. Putting hours into training employees will result in higher speeds at lower salaries than simply hiring “Expert” level employees.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/7494d84407ba6a98cae4a0d049788a55c4b49e5b.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now. Thanks for reading. I hope you enjoy Beta 14!

All the best,
Jonas

notes.title: Devlog #9
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

This week I’ve made a couple of improvements to the gameplay that I hope make the game feel less repetitive. 

[code]The devlog gives a sneak peek into what has been developed on the game over the past week. It is not a new release and is not available yet. New features are always released as official Beta releases.[/code]

[h1]Various changes/fixes[/h1]
🔵 Fixed bug that caused product creation to fail on slow CPUs.
🔵 The game now pauses when a bug occurs to avoid crashing the game/savegame.
🔵 Disabled Steam features (Bug reporting + Workshop) if Steam client is online.
🔵 Disabled error tracking if mods are detected (should improve bug fixing in the future).
🔵 Changed initial window size to 1024x768.
🔵 Fixed bug that caused the game to crash if pressing the space bar, 1 or 2 while initially loading.
🔵 Automatically create subfolders for savegames path if this is missing.
🔵 Added “Sent home” info on top of workstation window.
🔵 Fixed bug that caused desk upgrades to not give the correct office bonus.
🔵 Show employees in black/white to make it easier to recognize employees who are out of the office.
🔵 Rebalanced employee mood increase/decrease.
🔵 Close window when clicking outside of it.
🔵 Fixed bug that caused HR Manager to not show all managers.
🔵 Added “employee type to create” to the component popover.
🔵 Fixed yet another contract number issue.
🔵 Rebalanced contract competitors.
🔵 Enabled component popover for Lead Dev merging view.
🔵 Doubled the production time for all modules.
🔵 Added fadeout effect to desks for employees who are out of the office.
🔵 Added “Base Speed” in parentheses to employees list.
🔵 Removed daily stock revenue to prepare for upcoming “overtake” feature.
🔵 Fixed bug that caused the fee for overdue contracts to not be updated.

[h1]Pending Contracts[/h1]
Pending contracts are now being shown on the right-side overlay. This makes it much easier to respond to new contracts.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/e6fcff59c184ce51e68a3731e6eccb77bd164709.jpg[/img]

[h1]Send everyone home[/h1]
Finally, it’s happening! You can now send all employees home using your HR Manager. While employees won’t need as much rest as in Beta 13, it’s still a nice addition :-)
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/4b86518d6256b2ab28de84c69ff59f7b2a0bed0b.jpg[/img]

[h1]New server[/h1]
A brand new server type has been added called the “Small Server Cluster”. It is four times as powerful as the “Large Virtual Server”. You will no longer need to spam the “Add Instance” button :-)
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/22c3a0f147c2c89d61b4fa6df4044caacb0d86a3.jpg[/img]

[h1]Public Beta 14 testing![/h1]
Come help find the last remaining bugs in Beta 14 before it’s released next week. Please backup your savegames before doing this – it is a bug hunting process after all :-)

To switch to the Beta 14 test:
[list]

[*] Select [b]beta14-testing[/b].
[*] Start the game once Steam has finished updating.
[/list]

I’ve created a new sub-forum dedicated to testing Beta 14. If you find any bugs or glitches, you can report them here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/606800/discussions/3/

[code]Do you have suggestions or ideas for the game? 
Check out [url=http://status.startupcompanygame.com]our Conflux board[/url].[/code]

That’s all for now. Thanks for reading. I’ll be back next Friday :-)

All the best,

Instead, the manager’s main purpose is to help assign tasks and boost productivity by adding the speed bonus. This should help get rid of a substantial portion of early-game clicks :-)

[h1]Revised vacation controls[/h1]
The vacation feature is being renamed to “Send home”. You can now choose between 1 and 3 days. 3 days still guarantees that an employee’s mood will be at 100% upon their return to work, but most of the time 1 day is sufficient.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/62395434811bec120a75544a513906e11f86318c.jpg[/img]

[h1]Employee Training[/h1]
Yes, it’s finally here! Following a large number of requests on Conflux, I have decided to add an employee training feature:  
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/e4b521c181d3ea5852183b79418d0ec8b4837ab5.jpg[/img]
Each employee now has a “Max Speed” or “Potential Speed”. Once you’ve trained your employee to his/her maximum speed, you’ll be able to upgrade the employee. After upgrading, a higher “Max Speed” will now be available, until the employee reaches “Expert” level. The employee’s final “Max Speed” will vary from employee to employee. Putting hours into training employees will result in higher speeds than simply hiring “Expert” level employees.

🔵 Added achievement sync on game startup.
🔵 Corrected various typos in English translation.
🔵 Added “Controlled by Manager” label to all production employees. Allows the player to quickly switch to the manager.
🔵 Fixed issue where employees could not quit their job if seated on another floor than the one currently selected by the player.

[h1]Wrapping up Beta 14[/h1]

🔵 [b]Shared schedules:[/b] controlled by HR Manager. Introducing days off/weekends.
🔵 [b]Stock tracking:[/b] See how stocks change over time.
🔵 [b]Activity Log:[/b] The player is no longer required to close notifications.
🔵 [b]Production Feature:[/b] Managers can now control their team’s production of components/modules.
🔵 [b]Rebalanced products:[/b] Users are now capped at approximately 2bn and revenue has been nerfed a lot.
🔵 [b]Bigger Skyscraper:[/b] Skyscraper increased to 5 floors (120 workstation limit).

You can read more about all these features in the previous devlogs.

I still don’t have a public release date for Beta 14, but I hope to release it by early next month.

notes.title: Devlog #7
notes.notes:
[b]Hi everyone,[/b]

This week has been extremely productive! In addition to the changes below, I’ve also been working on launching Startup Company on another large online gaming platform. I recommend following [url=https://twitter.com/hovgaardgames] Hovgaard Games on Twitter if you’re interested in finding out more[/url].

[code]The devlogs gives a sneak peek into what has been developed on the game over the past week. It is not a new release and is not available yet. New features are always released as official Beta releases.[/code]

[h1]Changes this week[/h1]

🔵Fixed issue that was occurring when clicking “auto repeat” at the exact same time a task was completed.
🔵Fixed issue where it was impossible to rotate workstations after an employee was fired.
🔵Fixed issue where two Researchers working simultaneously would cause an error.
🔵Fixed issue where clicking notifications for deleted products would cause an error.
🔵Converted notifications into the new activity log.
🔵Added two new floors to the skyscraper, upping the maximum number of desks to 120 and the maximum number of floors to five.
🔵Fixed issue where product expenses were not showing when the game is paused.
🔵Reduced the number of server crashes.
🔵Improved error handling for corrupt savegames.
🔵Fixed NaN bug that was occurring when efficiency hit 90%.
🔵Fixed bug caused by Christmas Tree being removed.
🔵Added recovery feature to ensure savegames work with both the testing branch (beta 14) and beta 13.

[h1]Production Functionality[/h1]
The new automated production feature is currently being tested. Currently, you have to manually set the minimum stock amount for each available component/module. Once the limit is reached, employees stop working. I’m not entirely happy with the result as you never really want employees to stop working. Instead, I’m going to rewrite the feature to evenly produce items with a defined and met minimum stock.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/5c4eccf3e145152b5eb21aa8076531660f4aa1ae.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Activity Log[/h1]
The new activity log replaces the current notification system. Instead of hiding your notifications, you now get a static overview of all activity in the game.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/a3ce9d91f75fb44108199aae505f20041f308224.jpg[/img]

Right now, I’m working on the most requested feature in Beta 13 – the ability to move items/employees between floors.

That’s all for now. Thanks for reading. I’ll be back next Friday :-)

All the best,
Jonas

notes.title: Devlog #6
notes.notes:
[b]Hi everyone,[/b]

I hope you all enjoyed the holidays! 

Over the past couple of weeks, I’ve been working on rewriting the disk operations of the game. A lot of people experienced lag in the game because the game would wait for all disk operations to complete before resuming.

All operations have been moved to a second thread, ensuring that the main thread won’t be blocked anymore. It has been a tricky and time-consuming task, but I simply have to prioritize game breaking issues.

[code]The devlogs gives a sneak peek into what has been developed on the game over the past week. It is not a new release and is not available yet. New features are always released as official Beta releases.[/code]

[h1]Changes this week[/h1]

🔵Moved all disk operations to a detached thread.
🔵Delayed start of the game until both mods and savegames have been synced.
🔵Resolved issue so you can now upload new mods to Steam again.
🔵Automatically open Workshop URL when creating/uploading a new mod.
🔵Fixed UI issue on the mods dialog.
🔵Resolved a bug that was causing employees to not show up in the manager view.
🔵Updated incorrect Russian translations.
🔵Updated EULA (now approved by a lawyer).
🔵Fixed issue where the game would break if HR Manager quits due to low mood.

All the above changes were included in Beta 13.11, which will be shipped Monday morning.

With Beta 13.11 up and running, I plan to fully focus on Beta 14 again. 

That’s all for now. Thanks for reading. I’ll be back next Friday :-)

All the best,
Jonas

Another great week of work. Here's what I've completed:

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Resolved an issue causing Lead Devs to break when deleting feature instances they were working on.
    [*] Updated the savegame dialog to support duplicate saves.

    [*] Changed the finance view from showing the last 30 days to showing the next 30 days for your income.
    [*] Added a Christmas Tree (!!)

    [*] Resolved an issue causing modules to show invalid (and high) production time.

[h1]Merry Christmas[/h1]

As announced in the previous firday update I've been working on improving the HR Manager's functionality and tweaking the employees' need for vacation.

That's all for now. Thanks for reading. I'll be back next Friday :-)

All the best,
Jonas

notes.title: Devlog #3
notes.notes:
[b]Hi everyone,[/b]

Super busy week! Because of the release of Beta 13, I've been spending a lot of time replying to comments, fixing savegames and hunting down new bugs.

Overall the release has been pretty successful! Lots of players returned to the game. Peak was 188 concurrent players.

[h1]Bugfixes this week[/h1]

[list]
   [*]Fixed error message: "1:1:Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read property 'Web' of null"
    [*]Competitors list shown as empty or with $0 valuation.
    [*]Game not able to pause.
    [*]Components/modules in inventory shows as "NaN" or goes to 0. 
    [*]Wrong symlinks for Mac build.
    [*]Execute mods safely to avoid game crashes caused by mods.
    [*]Added versioning for error tracking + background worker tracking.
    [*]Fixed contracts stock at #21.
    [*]Execute mod events in safemode, to avoid game breaking when skipping to next day with bugged mods.
   [*]Fixed bug where first new server would crash instantly.
   [*]Added backwards-compatibility for some mods (missing enums).
   [*]Increased potential users.
   [*]Decreased response time by feature instances.
   [*]Fixed bug where corrupted savegames would crash the "Load Game" dialog.
   [*]Cleanup old completed contracts for smaller savegame files.
   [*]Cleanup deleted employees from managers (caused by bug in Beta 12)
   [*]When upgrading efficiency, requirements would show as NaN for every 10th upgrade.
   [*]When creating a new savegame (and not restarting the game), competitors list would be empty after 7 days. 
   [*]Increased (2x) CU and price per day for Large Virtual Server.
[/list]

In total I ended up shipping 7 hotfixes for Beta 13. It seems to be stable now. I do not plan on shipping more hotfixes for Beta 13, but if something comes up, I'll of course look into it.

Instead, I'm now going to focus on Beta 14. I don't have a list of planned features, but I'll keep you guys updated every Friday.

[h1]The New HR Manager[/h1]
The most annoying thing about the game (right now) seems to be sending employees on vacation. This will be fixed by introducing "Teams". Each HR Manager will represent one team which has it's own independent schedule.

[b]Shared schedule[/b]
All employees will now adapt to the schedule defined for the team. No more manually setting the schedule for each employee.

[b]Weekly day(s) off[/b]
The HR Manager can now control weekly days off for employees. Enough days off can almost eliminate the need for vacations.

You will also be able to switch between "combined" and "spread" mode. "Combined" will send employees on their day off at the same time. Spread will even it throughout the week.

That's all for now. Thanks for reading. I'll be back next Friday :-)

All the best,
Jonas

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.notes:
[b]Hi everyone,

Welcome to the first issue of [i]the devlog[/i]. [/b]

[h1]What is this update about?[/h1]
People have been repeatedly requesting more information, more updates and more builds. I've been thinking and this is my solution.

Shipping new builds (updates to the game) is very time consuming. I have to test them on all platforms and make sure everything works. Even if I just add a single piece of furniture, I can't just gamble and hope for the best. Everything has to be tested.

It is because of this I've decided not to change my release strategy. I will continue working towards big updates, bringing you one big update at a time, instead of wasting time releasing the same content in multiple smaller updates.

However, what I am changing is how often you will hear from me from here on out. Starting today, come Friday, I will release a [i]devlog[/i], showing you exactly what I've achieved in the past week.


[h1]Progress overview[/h1]
Since my last update an enormous amount of changes have been made to the game.

[b]Layering issues and isodom.js[/b]
We've finally managed to fix [u]every single layering bug[/u]! This is huge, because this bug has been present for more than 2 years. Furthermore, we've also decided to open source the engine behind Startup Company. We call it isodom.js and you can find it here: https://github.com/hovgaardgames/isodom.js

I would like to thank DonnySim for all his hard work on isodom. Much appreciated!

[b]New furniture[/b]
We've managed to put together a couple pieces of new furniture:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/f3c35a92b62de442e282b4724f02b495f8d43cb3.jpg[/img]

[b]Improved marketing[/b]
You can now customize marketing campaigns by defining a budget and timespan; and text ads no longer demand components. Effectively, this allows you to market your products from the moment you begin the game.

[b]Level based feature instances[/b]
Feature instances now have a level which will be upgraded as you improve them.

Servers are now capable of crashing, which will force you to implement new ones. This will put a constant demand on your DevOps, making the role much more important throughout the game.

notes.title: Gauges, Meters and Server Usage!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

It's been some time since you heard from me. I've been working hard on the upcoming (and first) content update for Startup Company.

Beta 13 will contain three remarkable updates:
[list]
    [*]Response time and "online users"
    [*]Feature instances
    [*]Huge performance improvements
[/list]

[h1]Response time and "online users"[/h1]
A picture is worth a thousand words:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/3fb75121b7f865aa9506e67f983d6ba1179c90bd.jpg[/img]
The product dialog is now much more exciting than earlier. The new Dashboard shows you [b]realtime analytics[/b]! Online users are constantly changing based on time of day, size of your userbase and any active marketing campaigns.

Response has been introduced. If your product becomes too slow, users will not convert and your conversion rate decreases. You will also start to lose your existing users if you do not improve the situation.

[h1]Feature instances and Infrastructure[/h1]
The new infrastructure view shows you a breakdown of your product:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/9a927cd16a7df3e98f61adc4f5379e0551b47386.jpg[/img]

Features are now limited to what is available for your selected product type (Social media, shopping platform, etc.). Researchers are able to produce "feature instances" that can be enabled on products. Instances have two properties: Quality and Efficiency. Quality determines how good the feature is and how many users it can attract. Efficiency determines how many server resources the instance will reserve. 

Keeping a low response time is done by a combination of improving efficiency of feature instances and installing servers. Servers are expensive, but improving efficiency takes time.

[h1]Beta 13[/h1]
The above is only the primary changes. Beta 13 will also contain updates that improves performance (more than ever), changes how marketing and servers work, plus various other improvements.

I'm super excited about this release. The update adds much needed complexity. It's targeted to all of us who loves numbers, stats and gauges!

Thanks for the continuous support, it's very very much appreciated!

All the best,
Jonas

notes.title: Premature Evaluation: Startup Company
notes.notes:
Every week we give Brendan a small loan and tell him to invest in an early access game. This week, the Silicon Valley-ing of Startup Company [official site]

Okay, here s the pitch. People love to share their photographs online, yeah? And people love to cook, yeah? Well, think of a food that people love to share, right? No. No, another type of food. No, okay, listen it s stew, the answer is stew. Right, people love to share stew, that s what we re getting at here. All right, so what if you had an app, yeah, that dynamically and innovatively shared stew? Like, not real stew, not actual stew in a pot, but just like little pictures of stew. Collectible stew. Dynamically. I know! I know. We re calling it StewPix. (more…)

notes.title: Beta 12.7 Released - The Performance Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I'm super excited to finally release this update to all of you. Since release the biggest complaint has been lag and performance issues when workstation count increases.

The solution was not easy and I'm not even done yet. I've been rewriting large parts of the code base to make rendering more efficient. This rewrite also allows me to improve performance further.

Hopefully this update will make the game playable for most players. I'm still targeting a lot of performance improvements in the future.

System requirements on the Store page have also been increased. I will reduce the requirements as more improvements are implemented.

[h1]Beta 12.6 changes (hotfix)[/h1]
- Issue causing some users not being able to load savegames

[h1]Beta 12.7 changes[/h1]

Features:
[list]
[*] Added Russian localization
[*] Added Turkish localization
[*] Disabled user loss for products until it's fully fixed (was causing players to lose all users overnight).
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Optimized the way workstation updates is rendered.
[*] Detached internal lifecycle from UI.
[*] Optimized amount of repaints to reduce CPU usage.
[*] Automatically disable Developer Mode after second launch (some players were not able to start game after enabling it).
[*] Optimized the way user growth was calculated (was exponentially increasing calculation time).
[*] Fixed bug where crashing mods could not be unsubscribed.
[*] Disable F5 and F12 shortcuts if Developer Mode is disabled.
[*] Increases amount of candidates generated.
[*] Fixed various translation issues.
[*] Show managers in HR Managers employee list.
[/list]

[h1]Next up[/h1]
Even though I would love to keep working on performance, I will now move my focus to fixing bugs. You have all been very active at reporting bugs, so I have plenty of work ahead of me :-)

Thank you for your attention, I hope you enjoy this update!

All the best,
Jonas

notes.title: Beta 12.5 Released
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I've been working non-stop since release fixing the current performance problems. Right now my highest priority is fixing game-breaking issues like this. When everyone is able to play the game I'll start fixing regular bugs. I hope you understand my priority.

[h1]Changes[/h1]

* Added safety measures to avoid corrupt savegames when saved to disk (atomic operation).
* Small performance improvements when rendering workstation changes. 
* Improved performance of "Jump to start of day".
* Ensure last savegame is not automatically loaded to ensure broken savegames won't crash the game.
* Automatically unload savegame and show error message if savegame is corrupt (no more endless loading spinner).

[h1]Next up[/h1]

Next up is rewriting the code that renders workstations. This is by far the most expensive mechanic in the game, so I do expect huge improvements. 

The rewrite will take time. I don't want to promise anything yet, but a new release will be pushed online as soon as it's done.

As always, thank you for all your massive support! Can't wait to start working on all your amazing suggestions.

All the best,
Jonas

notes.title: Post-Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

[h1]Much feels[/h1]
Wow. Just wow. This has been the craziest weekend, probably in my life. The Early Access release has been better, than I ever could have imagined. 

Within a few hours of release, Startup Company was present on Steam Global Top Sellers. More than 1000 concurrent players have been building companies non-stop since the release. I feel incredible humble and grateful. It's hard to believe. All of this would never have happened without you guys, the community. Thank you, really, the support has been tremendous!

So those of you who have been following me for some time, know that I'm not a full time game developer. I work as Web Developer and have created SC in my spare time. Well, that's about to change. In the future, I will work full time on Startup Company! As you can imagine, this allows me to put 2 or 3 times more hours into the development. I cannot wait. I got so much amazing feedback from all of you. Now it's time to really make this game awesome!

UPDATE: LIRIK just played the game. I'm absolutely starstruck! You can watch it here: https://www.twitch.tv/videos/166687767?t=01h15m51s

[h1]Beta 12.4 hotfix released[/h1]
No release without the need for an urgent hotfix. If you don't see the "Beta 12.4" in your main menu simply restart Steam for the update to kick in.
[list]
    [*]Exit button not clickable on small resolutions (less than 758 pixels height)
    [*]Moving workstation by mistake instead of selecting employee (Changed to left click to select, right click to move).
    [*]Mod archives was corrupted and didn't work on Mac/Linux under some scenarios. All mods has to be republished (sorry).
    [*]The Day 31-email was causing lots of people to believe I accused them for piracy. The paragraph has been removed (that was never my intention, you're my heroes!).
[/list]

[h1]Next update[/h1]
I'll now focus on the following:
[list]
    [*]Users suddenly drops overnight for products.
    [*]Performance/optimization issues in mid/late-game.
    [*]General minor bug fixing
[/list]

I'm trying to keep up with all the comments, emails, tweets, chat messages and bug reports. I'm sorry if you're still waiting. I'm doing everything I can to keep up :-)

That's all for now. Thank you for all your amazing support! 

See you till next update.

Jonas

notes.title: Steam Workshop, Mods and Beta 12!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Time for yet another update. Lots of stuff is happening in the basement (this is where I develop Startup Company).

[h1]Steam Workshop/Mods[/h1]
I've been putting a lot of hours into making a great workshop integration. 

When you're done creating a mod, all you have to do is click the "Upload to Steam" button. The currently logged in Steam account will be the owner of the mod, and every time you launch Startup Company from this account you will be able to update the mod directly from the game:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/8201d43ad46ea42220aa1e17386a5931934e2c60.png[/img]

notes.title: Competitors & Stocks
notes.notes:
[b]Hi everyone![/b]

I just wanted to share a neat concept I'm currently working on. 

A lot of you have asked about the possibility to see competing products. A lot of you have also requested some kind of stock market in-game. Guess what, that's exactly what I'm working on!

[h1]The competitors view[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/be8d17a2710144f614aae79f56043775d846aeb0.jpg[/img]

This new view shows you information about all the products currently available. All data is live and changes as the market evolves. It will also show your own products including your market share.

Clicking a product takes you to the product details views:

[h1]The product details view[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28693489/ba9be70d6921e7194d49aa6a5660af8fddf91124.jpg[/img]

This view shows you a breakdown of the selected product. This is also where you can buy and sell stocks. I will add a historic timeline showing the progress of stock value later on.

You earn money from products you own stocks in.



So that's it. Please notice that this is indeed concept work. Nothing official, everything is up for change. However the first playtests of the new feature looks promising. It feels like a great way of spending your money to earn money.

What do you guys think? Any suggestions for improvements? Please let me know in the comments below :-)

Thanks for the support!

All the best,
Jonas

notes.title: Building mods for Startup Company is super easy!
notes.notes:
The newly released Beta 10 includes a revised version of the mod support.

The new version allows you to easily create your own mods using regular web technologies like [b]HTML, CSS and Javascript[/b].

You can use [b]Chome Developer Tools[/b] to develop your mod. Simply turn on Developer Mode in the options view in Startup Company.

Example and documentation can be found on our Github Wiki:
[url=https://github.com/hovgaardgames/startupcompany/wiki/Modding]Startup Company Wiki: Modding[/url].

If you need any help, please don't hestitate to contact me directly on Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/hovgaardgames]Hovgaard Games Discord Server[/url]. My username is [b]jhovgaard[/b] and I'm almost always available to help you out, just leave me a DM :-)

I am currently working on adding support for pushing your mods to Steam Workship directly from the game. More on that later.

That's all for now. I am really really looking forward to see all your awesome ideas come to life!

All the best,
Jonas
